Ebijulizo

Ida Erios Nantaba munna'byabufuzi wa Uganda. Yeyali minista w'egwanga owebyempuliziganya ne technologiya (Uganda Ministry of Information and Communications Technology). Yalondebwa ku kifo kino ng'enaku zomwezi 6 sebbo aseka 2016. Mabega ko okuva enaku z'omwezi 15 Muwakanya 2012 okutusa nga 6 sebo aseka 2016, Yali minista w'ebyetaka. Nantabba era yemubaka omukyala owa distulikiti ye Kayunga (Kayunga District Constituency).

Gyenvude'we N'okusoma 
Nantaba bamuzalira mu Kayunga District nga 20 Ntenvu 1979. Kitaawe yafa mu 1984 nasigaza maama we yeka eyamulabirila ng'ayambibwako mwanyina (Samuel Kabenge Bamulumbye) eyasikira kiitawe. Yasomera Ndeeba Primary School mu Kayunga Districti okuva  1986 okutusa 1992 bweyatula ebibuzo bye eby'ekiibina eky'omusanvu. 

Maama we ne mwaanyina tebalina sente ezimala okumutwala mu somero elilungi ely'ebeyi kyebava bamutwala Ndeeba Senior Secondary School okusoomerayo siniya esooka mu 1993. Yamala nagenda okubeera ne mwanyina mu kyalo kisoga mu Kayunga District. Banakyalo ba Kisoga bajukira nga mwanyina bweyamuvugiranga ku kagali olugendendo lwa mailo munana buli lunaku okuva ewabwe okugenda kusomero. mu 1994, Maama wa Nantaba yafuna akasente namugya Ndeeba SSS namutwala Katikamu SDA SSS weyasomera siniya ey'okubiri kutusa ku siniya ey'okuna. yamala nawebwa ekifo ku Mukono Town Academy weyasomera siniya ey'okutano paaka ku siniya y'omukaga gyeyamaliliza mu musenene wa 1999

Nantaba yayingira  Makerere University, wamu ne mwanyina eyamutwalanga ku somero nasoma diguli mu by'obulambuze. Ku Univasite, yakola okunonyereza ku bimera ebivamu edagala oba bisobola okufuka eky'obulambuze nga agezesereza ku dindiro ly'ebisolo elya Uganda Wildlife Educational Center (UWEC)". yali alungamizibwa Professor J. B. Nyakaana. yamaliliza diguli ye mu 2003.

Obukugu bwe

2003–2015 
mu 2003, nga bamaze okumutikira e' Makerere, yakola nga ow'eby'obulambuze mu kampuni ya Pearl of Africa Tours and Travel Limited. Omulimo guno naguvako nga 2003 egwawo. Nga 2005 etandika, yali awereza ku kakiiko akafuzi aka Jordan Laboratories Limited, kampuni etunda ebyuma ebyozamu empapula n'ebikuba ebifananyi.

Mu 2010, yayingira eby'obufuzi eby'okwesimbawo  nga avuganya ku bubaaka bw'omukyala wa disitulikiti ye Kayunga. Yawangula akalulu k'anakwatira NRM bendera ng'asinga ayali aliko Florence Naiga.

Mu 2011 yawangula akalulu ka boona okufuka omubaka wa palamenti. mu kukyusakyusa kwaba minista nga 15 Muwakanya 2012, Yalondebwa nga minista w'ebyetaaka,  ng'adda mu bigere bya Sarah Opendi Achieng.  era yakakasibwa ku bwa minista akakiiko ka palamenti akavunanizibwa ku kukasa abalondedwa nga 23 Mukulukusa bitungo tungo 2012.

2015 paaka kati 
Mu 2015 Nantaba yawangulwa mu kalulu k'okulonda anakwatira NRM bendera mu kalulu kaboona. Yayabulira ekiibina kye ng'agamba nti akalulu kano tekaali ka bwenkaya nga bweyali atisatisiza okuva mu NRM singa bamubba mu kalulu. 

Mu kalulu ka boona akakubibwa enaku zomwezi 18 Mukutulansanja 2016, Nantaba eyali yesimbyewo nga talina kibina yawangula n'obululu 86,057 atte gweyali avuganya naye Ruth Nakacwa nafuna obululu 13,184. Eky'okuva mu NRM tekyamulemesa kulondebwa nga minista w'eby'empuliziganya ng'enaku zowezi 6 sebo aseka 2016

Ng'enaku zomwezi 24 Mugulansigo 2019, Nantaba  yali mu kanyolaganyo akavilamu polisi okuteka omuntu (Ronald Sebulime) ku mpingu nemukuba amasasi ng'emutebereza okugoberera Nantaba ng'akozesa pikki nekilowozo ky'okumutemula. 

Nga bamaze okudusa n'okukwata Ssebulime, yatekebwa ku mpingu nebamukuba amasasi abiri mu kifuba. Polisi yasoka neyagala ebikirile ekyikolwa kino ng'egamnba nti yali etangira etemu wabula abantu babiganira ddala ekyaletera polisi okukiriza ensobi yayo negulawo emisango ku bapolisi abakuba sebulime amasasi.

Ebirala byakola n'ebimufako 
Aidah Nantaba tanafumbirwa. Mukiriza mu kanisa y'Abadventi (Seventh-day Adventist). Ali mu palamenti ya Uganda ey'ekumi (2016–2021) ng'atalina kiibina. Akola ku bukiiko bwa palamenti buno wamanga:

 Akakiiko ku by'obulambuze, okusubula namakolero (Committee on Tourism, Trade and Industry)
 Akakiiko ku kiirwade kya silimu (Committee on HIV/AIDS and Related Matters)

Lilian Aber ye mubaka omukyala omulonde owa  Kitgum disitukulit mu palamenti ya Yuganda eyekumi nemu. Yasinga akalulu ng'ali ku kakonge ka NRM (National Resistance Movement) ekibiina ky'eby'obufuzi ekikulemberwa President wa Yuganda, Yoweri Museveni. Okusooma kwe 
Aber alina diguli mu lulimi olungereza (bachelor's degree in  English Language) wamu nempuliziganya okuva e Makerere University. alina ne diguli eyokubiri okuva kuUganda Christian University.

Emirimu Gyakozeko 
Eby'obufuzi Aber yabitandikira Makerere University. Mu mwaka gwe ogusoka ku Univasite, yasinga akalulu k'omubaaka wabayizi ku lukiiko olufuga abayizi e' Makerere. namala nalondebwa omukulembeze wabayizi Anna Ebaju Adeke okufuka minisita mu mwaka gwegumu. Mu mwaka gwe ogw'okubiri, yesimbawo kubw'omukulembeze wabayizi b'emakerere ng'ali ku kakonge k'ekibbina ky'ebyobufuzi ekya FDC (Forum For Democratic Change), naye nawangulwa Bwowe Ivan, eyamala namulonda ng'omumyuka we.

Ng'akola ng'omumyuka w'omukulembeze wabayizi, yasalawo neyesimbawo ku bukulembeze bwekiibina ekigata abayizi mu gwanga lyona ekya UNSA (Uganda National Students Union) ekifo kyeyawangula mu 2015, ng'adda mu bigere bya Matanda Abubaker (eyali omukulembeze wa UNSA okuva 2013 okutusa 2014).  Aber yamala nayabulila ekkibina kya FDC nada mukibbina kya NRM nga yetegeka okwesimba ku kifo ky'omukulembeze w'akakiiko k'abavubuka be gwanga (National Youth Council). ekifo kino nakyo yakiiwangula mu musene wa 2015 ng'alina obululu 119 ng'atte George Abudul eyali amuvuganya nafuna obululu 105.

Aber kati muwi wamagezi eli omukulembeze w'egwanga ku nsonga z'abavubuka ng'atte mubaka wabavubuka mu kiibina ky'awanga amagate (UN youth delegate). Aber  era yaliko omubaaka w'ekibbina ekigata abayizi bomumawanga agafugibwako bungereza. Mu 2018, Aber bamulonda ku kakiiko akakola enongosereza mu semaateka (constitutional review team). mu 2016 yesimbawo ku kifo ky'omubaka wa palamenti wa mawanga ga buvanjuba bwa Africa (East African Legislative Assembly(EALA).

Mu Gatonya wa 2021, Aber yawangula ekifo ky'omubaka omukyala owa disitulikiti ya Kitgum. yadda mu bigere bya Margaret Lamwaka Odwar eyagenda okukiikirila  abe Chua.

Ebijulizo

Veronica Namaganda Nanyondo munnabyabufuzi w'e Uganda mu kibiina kya National Unity Platform (NUP) eyazaalibwa nga 22 Ogwamusanvu (July) 1986 mu Disitulikiti y'e Bukomansimbi. Nanyondo ebyobufuzi yabitandika mu Gwekkumineebiri /December wa 2015 ng'ali wansi w'ekibiina kya Democratic Party(DP) oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwa muganda we Suzan Namaganda eyali afiiridde mu kabenje k'emmotoka. Nanyondo mu kiseera kino ye mubaka mu Paalamenti owa Disitulikiti y'e Bukomansimbi. Yasalawo okwesimba ku kifo kino olw'okwagala okwongereza ku bya muganda we Suzan Namaganda eyafa nga ye mubaka w'ekitundu ekyo n'alaba nga ye muntu omutuufu okumuddira mu bigere.

Obuyigirize bwe 
Nanyondo yatuula P7 mu 1998 ku ssomero lya Kisojjo Primary School. Yatuula ebya S4 mu 2002 mu ssomero lya Mende Kalema Memorial S.S. Yeeyogerayo ku haaya n'atuula S6 mu 2004 mu St. Andrew Kaggwa S.S oluvannyuma n'afuna ddiguli mu busomesa eya Bachelor of Arts in Education mu Makerere University.

Eby'emirimu gye 
Nanyondo emirimu gye yagitandika mu 2010 ng'akola nga kitunzi mu kkampuni ya Unique Business Systems okutuusa mu 2011. Wakati wa 2011 ne 2013 yali asomesa ku St.John SSS Mukono nga mu kiseera kino Dayirekita mu kkampuni ya Ver Stationaries Limited.  Mu kulonda kwa 2021 yategeka olukung'aana olw'awamu ne banne ab'ekibiina kya NUP kyokka ab'ekibiina ekiri mu buyinza bwe bavuganya aba National Resistance Movement- (NRM) era kw'olwo poliisi yajja n'erusazaamu.

Ebijulizo

Ye muntu azaaliddwa mu ggwanga lya Uganda. Bw'aba mukulu kimukakatako n'okuba ne densite (ennangamuntu) ya Uganda.

Janet Grace Akech Okori-Moe (eyazaalibwa nga 3 Ogwomenda1966) munnayuganda, musomesa ate era munnamateeka. Mu Gwokutaano 2020, Okori-Moe yafuuka omubaka omukyala akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Abim mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda) olw'ekkumi. Ku ludda lw'ebyobufuzi, Okori-Moe munnakibiina kya National Resistance Movement era nga kye yajjiramu mu kalulu ka 2016.

Okusoma kwe 
Okori-Moe yatuula ebibuuzo by'ekibiina eky'omusanvu (PLE) mu 1979 ku Abim Primary School. Yasomera ku Kangole Girls Senior Secondary School n'afuna  Uganda Certificate of Education (UCE) mu 1983 n'oluvannyuma n'agenda ku Moroto High School gye yafunira Uganda Advanced Certificate of Education (UACE) mu 1986. Okori-Moe era alina ddipulooma mu busomesa gye yafunira ku Makerere University (mu1989) ne Advanced Diploma in Educational Planning and Management gye yafunira ku Kyambogo University (mu 1999).Mu 2000 yafuna ddiguli mu Social Sciences ku Makerere University n'oluvannyuma n'afuna Master of Science in Social Sector Planning and Management mu 2006.

Emirimu gy'akoze 
Okori-Moe yasomesaako ku Moroto Teachers College (1992–1994) nga tannalondebwa kubeera mukiise ku kakiiko akaateekateeka ssemateeka wa Uganda (1994–1995). Yaweerezaako ng'omubaka mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga, 1996–2001 ne 2006–2011. Nga tannalondebwa mu kifo ky'aweerezaamu kaakano, yali muwabuzi wa ppulezidenti ku nsonga z'ebyenjigiriza (2013–2015).

Mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga olw'ekkumi, Okori-Moe ye ssentebe w'akakiiko akakwasaganya ensonga z'ebyobulimi,  ssentebe omubeezi w'akakiiko k'ensonga z'ebweru w'eggwanga mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda)  ate era nga mmemba ku  Appointments Committee.

Agnes Atim Apea munnayuganda, munnabbizineesi ate era munnabyabufuzi. Ye yatandikawo ekibiina kya Hope Development Initiative, era nga yafulumira mu lukalala lwa BBC olw'abakyala 100 ab'omwaka 2017. Emirimu gy'akoze 
Agnes Atim Apea ye ssentebe w'akakiiko ka Local Government Finance Commission ate era nga ye yatandikawo ekitongole kya Hope Development Initiative, ekitumbula abalimi b'omuceere abakyala mu bitundu bya Uganda eby'enjawulo. Eno y'ensonga eyamuleetera okupaatiikibwako erinnya "Mama Rice."  Ekitongole kye kiteeseteese ebitongole by'abalimi eby'obwegassi mu Uganda. Ng'oggyeeko omuceere, ebitongole by'abalimi eby'obwegassi era bikola ku nsigo ezikozesebwa okukola butto n'ebintu ebirala ebikolebwa mu muwogo.
Mu ngeri y'emu, Apea ye mubaka omukyala omulonde okukiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Amolatar (esangibwa mu bukiikakkono bwa Uganda) mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga.She is also the Woman Member of Parliament-elect for Amolatar District in Northern Uganda.

Mu 2017, Apea yafulumira mu lukalala lwa BBC olw'abakyala 100 ab'enkizo okwetooloola ensi yonna. Apea okutegeera engeri gye yafulumira mu lukalala luno yali agenze mu lusiisira lw'ebyobusuubuzi (7th African Grain Trade Summit) olwategekebwa mu ggwanga lya Tanzania, bwe kyamanyibwa nti olukalala yalugendako lwa kutumbula mazima na bwenkanya wamu n'okusomesa abakyala ebintu eby'enjawulo.

Okusoma kwe 
Apea alina PhD mu byenkulaakulana (Doctor of Philosophy in International Development) gye yafunira ku University of Reading. Alina ne Master's degree mu Development Studies okuva ku Uganda Martyrs University.

Ndamira Catherine Atwikiire (yazaalibwa nga 13 Ogwomunaana / August 1977) Munnayuganda omubazi w'ebitabo, mubaka mu Paalamenti era munnabizinensi.. Yaddamu okulondebwa ng'omubaka omukazi mu Paalamenti ey'e 11 owa Disitulikiti y'e  Kabale ng'esangibwa mu ttundutundu lya Kigezi Sub-Region era nga munnakibiina ky'ebyobufuzi ekiri mu buyinza ki National Resistance Movement. Yali ku kakiiko ka Paalamenti akabuuliriza ku nsimbi z'omuwiw'omusolo ne ku kakiiko akalondoola ku byobulamu mu Paalamenti ya Uganda ey'e 10. Era mmemba mu The Uganda Parliamentary Forum on Social Protection.

Emirimu gye 
Okuva mu 2010 - 2015, yali akola ng'ewebyenfuna mu kkampuni ya VIDAS Engineering Services Co. Ltd. Oluvannyuma yalondebwa ng'omubaka Omukazi akiikirira Disitulikiti y'e Kabale mu Paalamenti mu 2016. Atwikiire era yalondebwa okutuula ku kakiiko akagoberera ensonga z'omukago gwa Afrika ey'Obuvanjuba aka East African Community. Erammemba wa The Uganda Parliamentary Forum on Social Protection .

Ebimu ku by'akoze 
Ndamira Atwakire yawa aabantu b'e Kabale ebintu ng'ebizzi, ebijanjaalo, kasooli n'emboga. Yayongera amaanyi mu butale bw'omubitundu eby'enjawulo, n'abakolera amazzi ga ttaapu, yatwalayo z'abavubuka ng'okuggulawo SACCO z'abavubuka, Yagula ambyulensi okuyambako ku byobulamu mu kitundu kye ate era yatuukiriza n'ekiragiro eky'okuwanika amataala mu kibuga Kabale. Erayayambako ne mu kusitula ebyemizannyo mu Disitulikiti ye. Yawagira era n'akulaakulanya ebyenjigiriza mu Kabale bwe yeetaba mu kusonda ssente ezaazimba ettendekero lya Kagunga Technical School. Yawaayo eri eggwanga Uganda mu kusonda obuyambi mu kiseera kya COVID-19 nga yawaayo amafuta.

Ebijuliziddwamu 

Yuganda

Agnes Nandutu mukyala Munnayuganda era munnamawulire, munnabyabufuzi era Minisita omubeezi ow'e Karamoja. Mu 2020 yeetaba mu kalulu k'ekibiina ekya National Resistance Movement kye yafiirwa eri Memba wa Paalamenti omukyala Justin Khainza, era mu kulonda okw'awamu okwa 2021, yeesimbawo ku bwannamunigina, n'alondebwa ng'omubaka omukazi owa Disitulikiti y'e Bududa.

Emirimu gye 
Agnes Nandutu yazaalibwa mu Disitulikiti y'e Bududa mu Uganda. Yali nnakinku mu kuweereza amawulire ag'ebyobufuzi ku NTV Uganda. Nandutu yali aweereza ku mpewo era nga y'akubiriza pulogulaamu  ku NTV eyitibwa "Paalamenti y'abantu." yaweereza nga Pulezidenti w'ekibiina kya bannamawulire abasaka aga Paalamenti ekya Parliamentary Journalists' Association okuva mu 2011 okutuuka mu 2016. Ye muwandiisi era omunyumya w'akanyomero akaatiikirivu ennyo ku Lwokutaano aka Point Blank ku NTV Uganda. Mu 2011, yafuna ekirabo kye ekya ssekkukulu okuva mu The Observer ku lwa pulogulaamu ye ku NTV , eya Point Blank.

Obuto bwe n'emisomo gye 
Agnes ava mu buwangwa bwa Babantu obw'Abagisu. Nandutu Pulayimale ye yagisomera ku Bumwali primary school, era yeegatta ku Bbulo girls secondary era oluvanyuma yeegatta ku Blucheke secondary school mu misomo gye egya Siniya eya waggulu.  Mu 1997, yeegatta ku Radio Uganda  ng'omuweereza w'amawulire. Oluvanyuma, yafuma Dipuloma mu mawulire ku ttendekero lya Uganda Institute of Journalism and Media studies. Yakolerako ku Daily Monitor ng'omuweereza w'amawulire atali mukozi wa nkalakkalira. Wakati wa 2002–2008, Agnes yakolerako ku Impact FM ng'omuweereza w'amawulire omujjuvu nga tanneegatta ku NTV Uganda.

Ebirala 
Mu 2017, Nandutu yammibwa olukusa Dayirekita w'ebyempuliziganya okuweereza amawulire agafa mu Paalamenti y'a Uganda.

Mu 2020 mu kaseera ka kakuyege wa Paalamenti, Nandutu yasabibwa okwanjula omwami we, ekintu ky'ataakola wabula n'asaba akakiiko akakwasaganya eby'okulonda nga ayita ku Ladiyo okumufunirayo amusaanira era n'abeegayirira okufaayo ku buweeereza obulungi mu kifo ky'obufumbo. ensonga y'obufumbo yaleetawo akabuuza mu bantu.  Nandutu yakkiriza nti maama w'abaana musanvu newankubadde yasaba aleme kwogera bingi ku nsonga eyo mu kiseera weyali mu kafubo ne munnawulire w'olupapula lwa Observer.

Ebijuliziddwamu

Mary Paula Kebirungi Turyahikayo era amanyiddwa nga Turyahikayo Kebirungi Mary Paula (yazaalibwa nga 15 Gatonnya / January 1961) Munnayuganda nga munnabyabufuzi era eyasoma embeera z'abantu. Ye mubaka mu Paalamenti owa konsitityuwensi y'e Rubabo,mu Disitulikiti y'e Rukungiri wansi w'ekibiina ki National Resistance Movement (NRM). Yavuganya ku kifo kino mu 2021-2026 naye n'awangulwa ng'afunye obululu 20,287.

Ebyokusoma kwe 
Mu 1974, yatandika okusoma mu St. Theresa Primary School era gye yatuulira ebigezo bya P7, olwo oluvannyuma ne yeegatta ku Immaculate Heart Girls Senior Secondary School era gye yatuulira S4 mu 1978.  Kyokka S6 yo yagituulira mu Kibuli S.S mu 1980. Yabeebwa ekifo mu Yunivaasite e Makerere n'asomayo ddiguli mu mbeera z'abantu eya Bachelor's degree of Arts in Social Sciences (Political Science, Sociology) mu mwaka 1984. Mu 1997, yasomayo satifikeeti mu bukulembeze oluvannyuma lwa ddiguli mu ttendekero lya Uganda Management Institute. Mary era yaddayo ku Uganda Management Institute n'afunayo Dipulooma mu by'obukulembeze mu 2000 era oluvannyuma yaddayo n'asomayo ddiguli eyookubiri eya Master of Public Health Leadership mu 2009.

Emirimu gye nga tannatandika byabufuzi 
Yali musomesa era nga y'akulira essomo ly'Ebyafaayo ku ssomero lya Baptist High School, Mombasa, Kenya(1986-1988) ne ku Afraha High School, Nakuru, Kenya (1988-1990). Mu 1994, yeegatta ku puloogulaamu ya Africa Science Technology Exchange nga y'agikulembera oluvannyuma ne yeegatta ku  Minisitule y'ebyobulamu gye yaweereza mu kuddukanya emirimu gya Minisitule egya bulijjo (1998-2004). Okuva awo, yakolako ng'amyuka akulira enzirukanya y'emirimu mu kitongole ekiddukanya emirimu gya Gavumenti ekya Public Sector(2004-2005). Era yakolao ng'amyuka akulira eby'emirimu mu kitongole kya Global Fund to fight AIDS, TB, Malaria (2004 - 2005). Yakolako ng'omu ku banoonyereza ku African Energy Policy Research Network, era ng'omusomsa w'essomo ly'Ebyafaayo ne Kayigansi (Geography) mu masomero gy'e Kenya.

ebyobufuzi 
Okuva mu 2006 - 2021, yaweereza ng'omubaka mu Paalamenti ya Uganda  okuli Paalamenti ey'omunaana, ey'omwenda n'ey'ekkumi. Mu 2001 yawangula eyali Minisita era aliko cansala wa Makerere University, Prof. Mondo Kagonyera, ku kifo ky'omubaka wa Rubabo Konsitityuwensi.

Mu Paalamenti yeeyongerako obuvunaanyizibwa obulala okubukiiko bwa Paalamenti obw'enjawulo, mu bitongole bya Gavumenti eby'enjawulo ne bizinensi za Gavumenti ez'enjawulo.

Ebyomunda ebimukwatako 
Mufumbo. By'anyumirwa mu biseera bye eby'eddembe anyumirwa okuwuliriza ennyimba ez'eddiini, okukyalira mikwano gye, okutambulako n'okukubaganya ebirowoozo. Ayagala nnyo okutumbula ebyobulamu n'abavubuka abawala mu ggwanga.

Christine Tubo Nakwang era amanyiddwa nga Nakwang Christine Tubo Munnayuganda era nga munnabyabufuzi ngaye Mubaka omukazi akiikirira Disitulikiti y'e Kaabong mu Paalamentiya Uganda. Christine y'omu ku baali ba kkaada b'ekibiina ky'ebyobufuzi ekyaNational Resistance Movement (NRM) mu kalulu k'okuddamu okulonda omubaka waayo mu 2021 nga kino kyajjawo olwa Rose Lily Akello eyali omubaka omukazi owa Disitulikiti eyo yali asazeewo okugisuulawo yeesimbewo okukiikirira Disitulikiti eyali yaakatondebwawo eya Karenga eyali ekutuddwa ku Kaabong. Nakwang mu kamyufu yawangula Fadouta Ahmed ne Agnes Napio nga nabo baali wansi wa NRM. Yavuganya ne  Judith Adyaka Nalibe ow'ekibiina ky'ebyobufuzi ekya Forum for Democratic Change (FDC) ng'ono oluvannyuma yasalawo okuva mu lwokaano olw'ebyali biyiting'ana nti ekibiina kye kyali tekimuwadde buwagizi. Ebimu ku by'ayagala okutereeza e Kaabong kwe kutumbula omutindo gw'ebyenjigiriza. .

Gy'ava n'ebyokusoma kwe 
Nakwang yazaalibwa nga 7 Ogwekkuminoogumu / November 1967 mu Disitulikiti y'e Kaabong. Yasoma gwa bubazi bwa bitabo. Yatandikira olugendo lwe olw'okusoma mu ssomero lya Komukuny Girls Primary School era n'atuulirayo ebigezo bya PLE mu 1982. Yeegatta ku Kangole Girls Secondary School era gye yatuulira ebigezo bya S4 mu 1986. Oluvannyuma eegatta ku ssomero lya Moroto High school gye yatuulira S6 mu 1989. Yeeyunga ku Nkumba University gye yasomera era n'atikkirwa Dipulooma mu bubazi bw'ebitabo (Diploma in Accounting) mu 1992. Yeeyongerayo kuKampala International University  gye yasomera Ddiguli esooka mu by'okuddukanya Buzinensi (Bachelor's Degree in Business administration (BBA) mu 2006.

Ebyemirimu gye 
Christine yatandikira mubusomesa ku ssomero lya Komukuny boys primary School ne mu Kaabong senior Secondary School. Yafuuka akola ng'omumyuka w'omukulu w'essomero mu Kangole Girls S.S mu mwaka 1990. Okuva mu 1993 -1994 yali akola mu ofiisi y'ebyensimbi ku kitebe kya Eklezia Katolika e Moroto. Mu 1995, Yafuuka omulabirizi era omukuumi w'etterekero lya ly'ekitongole kya Oxfam GB Kotido Field office, oluvannyuma n'afuuka omuwanika wa Dodoth Agro-pastoralist development Organization. Yeeyongerayo ne yeegatta ku Terra Firma Construction Company ng'akulira okuddukanya emirimu gyayo. Mu kiseera kye kimu yali aweereza nga kkansala wa LC5 mu Disitulikiti y'e Kaabong okuva mu 1996 - 2000. Mu bbanga wakati wa 20001 - 2011 yaweereza ng'omubaka mu Paalamenti owa Disitulikiti y'e Kaabong. Mu 2012 - 2015 yafuuka mmemba ku lukiiko oluddukanya emirimu mu disitulikiti y'e Kaabong era n'addamu okufuuka mmemba mu Paalamenti okuva mu Gwomwenda / September wa 2019 okutuusa kati

Ebyobufuzi 
Christine yatandika olugendo lwe olw'ebyobufuzi n'obukulembeze nga kkansala wa LC5 ku lukiiko lwa Disitulikiti y'e Kaabong okuva mu 1996 - 2000. Yavuganya mu kalulu ka bonna akaaliwo mu 2016 era n'awangula eky'Omubaka omukazi owa Disitulikiti y'e Kaabong nga ku luno yeesimbawo ku bwannamunigina. Mu kulonda kuno okwa 2016, Akello Lucy teyamatira ku buwanguzi bwa Nakwang kwe kuddukira mu kkooti n'amuwaabira. Nakwang yaggyibwa mu Paalamenti n'adda ku bbali era okulonda okw'okuddamu akalulu ako okwakolebwa mu mateeka, Akello akuwangula n'adda mu bigere bya Nakwang mu 2017.Akello Lucy bwe yasalawo okukiikirira Disitulikiti y'e Karenga, ekifo kino yakivaamu n'akireka nga kyereere kwe kutegeka okuddamu okulonda mu 2019 okujjuza ekifo kino mu 2019 Nakwag kwe yawangula n'addamu okufuuka omubaka mu Paalamenti owa Disitulikiti y'e Kaabong. Yaddamu okwesimbawo ku kifo kyekimu mu kulonda kwa bonna okwa 2021 ku kkaadi ya NRM  era n'awangula.

 Website of the Parliament of Uganda

Emma Boona (Eyazalibwa enakuzomwezi 17 omwezi gwa mukutulansanja 1954) musomesa muna Yuganda era muna'byabufuzi. Yaliko omubaaka omukyala owa Mbarara District mu palamenti ey'omunana neye kumi era omukiise wa National Resistance Movement (NRM), ekibbina ky'ebyobufuzi ekifuga Uganda.

Ng'akyali omubaka, yawereza ng'omumyuka wa sentebbe wakakiiko akakwasaganya ebyemilimu ne Gavumenti yamakati atte yali mukiise ku kakiiko k'ebyensimbi, entekateka wamu n'enkulakulana mu byenfuna wamu n'akakiko akalondola ensasanya ya Gavumenti mu palamenti ya Yuganda. 

Yali mukiise ku kiwayi kya NRM mu palamenti era omukise mu kibbina ekigata ababaka abakyala mu palamenti ya Uganda(Uganda Women's Parliamentary Association (UWOPA).

Boona era yaliko Omumyuka wa sentebbe w'olukiiko lwa district y'embarara (Local Council Five (LC5), era yaliko n'omomyuka wa mayor wa Mbarara Munisipali.

Yawerazako ng'omukulu w'esomero lya Mbarara Secondary School era yali musomesa mumasomero agawerako mu bugwa'njuba bwa Uganda.

Obulamu bwe obw'edda n'okusoma kwe 
Boona bamuzalira mu disitulikiti ye Bushenyi, mu Ankole ng'enaku zomwezi 17 mukutulansanja 1954 mu maka g'enzikiriza y'eki kulisitayo. okusoma kwe yakutandikira ku St. Cecilia Girls' School Kitabi-Bushenyi ne St. Helen's Primary School – Mbarara, we'yatulira ebibuzo bye eby'ekina ky'omusanvu (PLE certification) mu 1967.

Yamala neyeyunga ku  Maryhill High School okusooma siniya esooka paaka ku y'okuna (O-Level) mu 1971, namala nada Trinity College Nabbingo weyasoomera siniya ey'okutano paaka ku y'omukaaga (A-Level) mu 1973.

Boona yeyongerayo okusooma neyeyunga ku Makerere University weyasoomera diguli ne dipuloma mu byenjigiriza gyeya'tikirwa mu 1977. Mu 2006, yatikirwa diguli ey'okubiri mu kubalirira n'okudukanya eby'enjigiriza okuva mu Ssetendekero wa Mbarara University of Science and Technology (MUST).

Gyenvundde we' mu by'obufuzi 
Nga yakatikirwa digtuli ye esooka mu 1977, Boona ya'somesa mu zi siniya z'omubugwa'njuba bwa Uganda okutusa 1984 lwe yalondebwa okuba omukulu w'esomero lya Mbarara Secondary School lye yakulira okumala emyaka kumi n'enna. Mu 1991, Yafuka omumyuka wa mayor wa munisipali y'eMbarara. yawereza mu kifo kino paaka 1998 bweyalondebwa ng'omumyuka wa ssentebbe wa LC eyokutaano owa disitulikiti y'embarara.

Okuva 2002 okutusa 2008, Boona yali akiikirira Uganda mu kiibbina ky'ensi yona ekikwasaganya eby'okubalilira mu kuzaala (International Planned Parenthood Federation) – Mu kibangirizi ky'africa (IPPFAR) nga nakywewa mu kitingole kya Reproductive Health Uganda (RHU).

Mu 2006, Boona yagenda mumaso nokuwereza abantu b'eMbarara era yesimbawo ng'omubaka w'abakyala ba disitulikiti y'e Mbarara ngali ku kakonge ka NRM era nawangula akalulu k'anakwata bendera ya NRM mu 2005 atte nawangula n'akalulu ka boona mu 2006 okufuka omubaka mu palamenti ya Uganda ey'omunana. Mu 2011, abantu b'e Mbarara bamulonda ku kiisanja eky'okubiri eky'emyaka etaano. 

Mu 2015, Rosette Kajungu Mutambi yasinga Emma Boona mu kalulu k'okulonda anakwatira NRM bendera mu kalulu ka 2016 kubw'omubaka omukyala owa disitulikiti y'eMbarara.

Mu palamenti ey'omunnana n'ey'omwenda, Boona yali mukkise ku kakkiko ku by'ensimbi,okubalirira n'ebyenkulakulana wamu n'akakkiko ku nsasanya ya gavumenti mu palamenti. yali mukiise ow'ekiiwayi kya NRM mu palamenti atte wamu n'ekkibbina ky'ababaka abakyala mu palamenti kyebayita (UWOPA).

Mu palamenti eyo munnana, Boona yali awereza ng'omumyuka wa ssentebe w'akkiko akalondola ekitongole kya Gavumenti ekkikwasaganya eby'emilimo wamu n'akakkiko ku Gavumenti ez'ebitundu. Era yali akkikirira bugwa'njuba bwa Uganda mu kibbina ekigata ababaka abakyala mu palamenti ekya UWOPA.

Ebimukwatako Ng'omuntu 
Emma Boona mukyala wa' Chris Boona era balina abaana. akulira wamu nokuwa amagezi ebibbina by'obwegasi ebitereka n'okuwola sente (SACCOs) mu disitulikiti y'e Mbarara era ali  ku' bukkiko obudukanya amasomero obw'amasomero mangyi.

Norah Bigirwa-Nyendwoha (Yazaalibwa nga 19 Ogwekkumi / October 1968) Munnayuganda ate nga mubaka Omukazi mu Paalamenti. Mu 2016, Yalondebwa ng'omubaka Omukazi akiikirira Disitulikii Buliisa. Mu kulonda kwa Uganda okwa bonna okwa 2021 yaddamu okulondebwa akiikirire ekitundu kye kimu.

Mmemba w'ekibiina ky'ebyobufuzi ekiri mu buyinza ki National Resistance Movement.

Ebyokusoma kwe 
Mu 1992, Norah yatikkirwa Dipulooma mu byabizinensi (Business Studies) mu ttendekero lya National College of Business Studies erisangibwa e Nakawa.

Mu 1995, yatikkirwa era n'afuna satifikeeti mu by'okubala ebitabo (Accounting Technician Certificate) okuva ku ttendekero lya Uganda Management Institute. Era mu ttendekerolye limu gye yatikkirwa Dipulooma mu ssomo ly'ebyenfuna (Finance Officers Diploma) nga wayiseewo emyaka ena (4).

Mu 2003, yatikkirwa Ddiguli esooka mu Ndejje University ng'afuna Ddiguli mu kuddukanya bizinensi (bachelor's degree of Business Administration).

Maria Emily Lubega Mutagamba (yazaalibwa nga 5 Ogwomwenda / September 1952 – n'afa nga 24 Ogwomukaaga / June 2017). Yali Munnayuganda nga munnabyanfuna era munnabyabufuzi. Yaliko Minisita w'Ebyobulambuzi, ebisolo by'omunsiko n'eby'omumazzi mu Kabineeti ya Uganda okuva nga 15 Ogwomunaana / August 2012 okutuuka nga 6 Ogwomukaaga / June 2016.

Okuva mu 2011 okutuusa 2012, ye yali minisita w'amazzi n'Obutonde bw'ensi. Era yaweerezaako ng'omubaka Omukazi owa Disitulikiti y'e Rakai mu Paalamenti okuva mu 2001 okutuusa mu 2016.

Gye yazaalibwa n'obuyigirize 
Mutagamba yazaalibwa mu Disituliki y'e Rakai nga 5 Ogwomwenda / September 1952. Yasomera mu St. Aloysius Senior Secondary School e Bwanda, mu Disitulikiti y'e Kalungu  era gye yatuulira S4 u 1970. Yeeyongerayo ku ssomero lya Mount Saint Mary's College Namagunga mu Disitulikiti y'e Mukono gye yatuullira S6 nga yasomerayo wakati wa (1971–1972). Yeeyongerayo mu Makerere University okuva mu 1973 okutuusa mu 1976, n'atikkirwa Ddiguli mu Byenfuna eya Bachelor of Arts in economics. Era yafuna ne Dipulooma mu kompyuta eya computer programming mu ttendekero lya ICL Computer School e Nairobi, Kenya, nga yagifuna mu 1980, n'afuna ne satifikeeti mu byobukulembeze okuva mu ttendekero lya John F. Kennedy School of Government e Cambridge, Massachusetts, mu Bungereza (United States), ng'eno yagifuna mu 1997. Mu 2013, yaweebwa Ddiguli ey'ekitiibwa kya Dokita (an honorary doctorate in law) okuva mu McMaster University e Canada.

Emirimu gye 
Mutagamba yakolako mu Bbanka ng'akolera mu Bbanka ya Uganda Enkulu okuva mu 1976 okutuuka mu 1980 oluvannyuma yafuuka Dayirekita wa Bbanka okuva mu 1991 okutuuka mu 1999. Mu 1999–2000, yafuuka mumyuka wa Ssaabawandiisi w'ekibiina ky'ebyobufuzi ekya Democratic Party. Mu 2000, yalondebwa okufuuka Minisita omubeezi ow'ensonga z'amazzi ate mu 2006 n'alondebwa okufuuka Minisita omujjuvu ow'amazzi n'obutonde bw'ensi, nga yabeera mu kifo kino okutuuka mu 2012. Ye yali Pulezidenti w'olukiiko lwa Baminisita b'ensonga z'amazzi ab'omu Afrika yonna  okuva mu 2004 okutuuka mu 2012 era akwataganya ekibiina k'abakazi abafaayo ku mazzi n'obuyonjo mu nsi yonna ekya Global Women Leaders Forum for Water and Sanitation okuva mu 2005 okutuuka mu 2012. Era yamyukako n'akulira ekitongole kya United Nations Task Force on Integrated Water Resource Management. Ajjukirwa nnyo olw'okukola ennyo olw'okulaba ng'amazzi amayonjo gabuna mu bantu ne mu kitongole kya Global Water Harvesting Network.

Mutagamba yaweerezaako nga Minisita w'Ebyobulambuzi,  ensolo ez'omunsiko n'ebiramu ebibeera m mazzi okuva nga 15 Ogwomunaana / August 2012 okutuuka nga 6 Ogwomukaaga / June 2016 nga yasikizibwa Ephraim Kamuntu. Bwe yali Minisita, ajjukirwa olw'okutumbula ebyokulya omuli emagi, enva endiirwa ne chapati gye bazingamu eggi emanyiddwa nga Rolex. Yakomyawo n'empaka za Nnalulungi wa w'ebyobulambuzi owa Uganda. Yava mu byobufuzi mu 2016 olw'obulwadde obwali bumubala embiriizi.

Obirala ebimukwatako ng'omuntu 
Yafumbirwa Tarsis Matthew Mutagamba eyali omukozi wa Bbanka enkulu eya Uganda okumala emyaka 17 okutuusa lwe yalekulira mu 1980. Y'akulira ababazi b'ebitabo aba Bbanka Omuddugavu eyasooka mu Afrika. Tarsis yafa ndwadde ya Mutima nga 2 Gatonnya/ January 2004 ng'alina emyaka 70. Yaleka azadde abaana 16.

Okufa kwe 
Mutagamba yafa nga 24 Ogwomukaaga 2017 ku ddwaliro lya Case Medical Centre mu Kampala oluvannyuma lw'okulwala Kookolo w'ekibumba (liver cancer), kyokka nga yalina n'endwadde endala nga gallstones. Yafiira ku myaka 64 oluvannyuma lw'okumala ku kitanda wiiki ssatu ng'olumbe lumubala embiriizi. Ssaabaminisita wa UgandaRuhakana Rugunda bwe yali ayogera ku kufa kwe yagamba nti "Okufa kwa Mutagamba ddibu ddene eri eri Eggwanga lino - Uganda". Yaziikibwanga 28 Ogwomukaaga 2017 ku kyalo Gamba, mu Ggombolola y'e Kakuuto mu Disitulikiti y'e Rakai. Mmisa ey'okusabira omugenzi yakulemberwa eyali Omusumba w'Essaza ly'e Masaka mu Eklezia Katolika, kati naye omugenzi John Baptist Kaggwa.

Akiikiridde eggwanga lye (Uganda) mu mpaka ez'enjawulo naddala  eziri ku mutindo ogw'ensi yonna omuli: the 2016 Summer Olympics, 2014 World University Cross Country Championships, 2014 Commonwealth Games, 2013 Summer Universiade, ne mu 2012 World Junior Championships in Athletics.

2014 
Mu 2014, Uganda ye yategeka empaka za  Universiade World Cross Country Championships. Wano Nanyondo yakulemberamu ttiimu eyawangulira mu busikonda 30.

Ekiseera ekyaddirira mu mwaka ogwo yayongera ku mutindo n'awangula emisinde egya mmita 800 ng'addukidde eddakiika 1:59.27 mu mpaka za Golden Spike Ostrava.

Bwe waayitawo akaseera katono yeeyongera okulinnyisa omutindo gwe mu mbiro eza mmita 800 bwe yaddukira eddakiika 1:58.63 n'akwata ekyokusatu emabega wa Eunice Sum (1:57.92) eyakwaya ekyokubiri ne Ajee' Wilson (1:57.67) eyawangula empaka zino eHerculis mu kibuga Monaco ekya Bufalansa.

Mu mpaka eza Commonwealth Games mu kibuga Glasgow, Scotland, 2014, Nanyondo yawangula omujoozi ogw'ekikomo bwe yamalira mu kifo ekyokusatumu mpaka ez'akamalirizo ez'emisinde egya mmita 800 ng'addukidde eddakiika 2:01.38, ng'akulembeddwa Munnakenya Sum ne Lynsey Sharp owa Scotland eyaziwangula.

2015-2016 
Mu 2015 ne 2016, emisinde gye gyakendeeramu ng'asussa mu ddakiika ebbiri mu gya mmita 800. Kino bwe kyali bwe yaddukira eddakiika 2:01.97 mu misinde gy'e Kortrijk, Belgium nga 11 Ogwomusanvu / July 2015, n'akwata Ekyokusatu. Mu mizannyo egya 2016, egya Olympics mu kibuga Rio de Janeiro, ekya Brazil, yawandukira ku mutendera ogusooka mu misinde egya mmita 800, bwe yakwata ekifo eky'omukaaga nga yaddukira eddakiika 2:02.77.

Kyokka mu kiseera ekyaddirira yayongeramu amaani bwe yeetaba mu mpaka eza mmita 1500 mu kibuga Kawasaki ekya Japan nga 10 Ogwokutaano/ May 2015, n'amalira ku ddakiika 4:17.13.

Obuyigirize 
Yasoma bya misono / industrial art and design mu Kampala University.

Pamela Nasiyo Kamugo (eyazaalibwa nga 23 Ogwokutaano 1984) munnayuganda munnamateeka. Okuva mu Gwokuna 2020 okutuusa kaakano abadde aweereza ng'omubaka omukyala akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Budaka mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda) olw'ekkumi. Ku ludda lw'ebyobufuzi ali mu kibiina kya National Resistance Movement.

Ebimukwatako n'okusoma kwe 
Pamela Nasiyo Kamugo yasomera ku Kamonkoli Mixed Primary School. Bwe yava eyo yagenda ku St. Johns Secondary School, Ntebetebe gye yamalira siniya ey'okuna (n'afuna Uganda Certificate of Education) ne siniya ey'omukaaga (n'afuna Uganda Advanced Certificate of Education). Mu 2007 yagenda ku Uganda Christian University, Mukono n'afuna bachelor's degree in Social Work and Social Administration.

Emirimu gy'akoze 
Nga tannagenda mu byabufuzi, Kamugo yaweereza abantu ba bulijjo mu ddisitulikiti ya Mbale. Mu 2016, Kamugo yeesimbawo era n'awangula ekifo ky'omubaka omukyala akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Budaka mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga. Mu kuwangula ekifo ekyo, yaddira Sarah Kataike Ndoboli mu bigere. Mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga olw'ekkumi aweereza nga ssentebe w'ekitongole kyaUganda Women Parliamentary Association (UWOPA). Mu ngeri y'e,u, Kamugo mmemba ku bukiiko obulwanyisa akawuka ka mukeenenya n'endwadde endala wamu n'okubeera mmemba ku kakiiko k'ebyokwerinda n'akensonga z'omunda mu ggwanga.

Mu mwaka gwa 2017, Kamugo yakwatibwa ne bannamateeka banne abalala basatu olw'okukuma mu batuuze omuliro beegugunge olw'ekkubo lya Mbale-Tirinyi-Kampala ebbi.

Mu mwaka gwa 2019, Kamugo yawaayo ekiteeso mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga ekyaviirako omubaka wa Uganda mu Burundi okuggyibwako obuvunaanyizibwa obwo olw'okulumbagana wamu n'okuyisaamu omuserikale wa ppoliisi omukyala amaaso.

Ebijulizo

Nandagire Christine Ndiwalana munnayuganda ate munnabyabufuzi. Yalondebwa okubeera omubaka mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga mu kalulu ka bonna aka 2021. Yajjira ku kkaadi y'ekibiina kya National Unity Platform era nga ye mubaka omulonde okukiikirira Bukomansimbi ey'omu bukiikakkono mu ddisitulikiti ya Bukomansimbi.

Obulamu bwe 
Nandagire Christine Ndiwalana alina bachelor's degree in medicine and surgery gye yafunira ku Makerere University. Nga tannakyusa mannya ge kuyitibwa Nandagire Christine Ndiwalana mu 2018, yali akozesa mannya ga Christine Nandagire.

Mu Gwomunaana gwa 2019, Nandagire yalangirirwa ng'omuntu agenda okukwata kkaadi y'ekibiina kya Democratic Party mu lwokaano lw'okulonda omubaka omukyala akiikirira Bukomansimbi ey'obukiikakkono mu ddisitulikiti ya Bukomansimbi. Wabula oluvannyuma yeeyunga ku kibiina kya National Unity Platform. Olw'emivuyo egyayabuluza ekibiina kya National Resistance Movement mu kitundu kye, yamegga omubaka eyaliko, Ruth Katushabe okwesogga olukiiko lw'eggwanga mu kisanja ekya 2021-26.

Ebijulizo

Betty Oyella Bigombe, Bangi gwebamanyi nga  Betty Atuku Bigombe (yazalibwa enaku zomwezi 21 mu mwezi gwa mukulukusa bitungotungo mu mwaka gwa 1952), yawerezako nga Senior Director for Fragility, Conflict, and Violence ku Banka yensi yoona okuva 2014 okutusa 2017. Yalondebwa ku kifo kino mu sebo aseka wa 2014. 

Okuva mu Muzigo wa 2011 okutusa sebo aseka wa 2014, yali minista w'eby'amaazi. Yalondebwa ku kifo kino enaku zomwezi 27 muzigo 2011. mu budde bwe bumu yali awereza ng'omubaka omukyala owa disitulikiti ye Amuru. Yalekulila ebifo byombi nga 1 sebo aseka 2014.

Ebyafayo n'okusoma kwe 
Betty Bigombe bamuzalira mu Amuru District, ng'enaku z'omwezi 21 mu mwezi gwa mukulukusa bitungotungo mu  1952, nga Amuru ekyali ekitundu ku Acholi Disitricti. yali omu ku baana kumi n'omu aba Kitaawe eyali omusawo. bigome  mu'choli. Yasomera Gayaza High School siniya essoka paaka ku y'okuna mu mwaka gwa 1968 namala neyegata ku Trinity College Nabbingo gyeyasomera siniya ey'okutano ney'omukaga mu 1970. 

yamala nayingira Makerere University,  gyeyasomera diguli ya (Bachelor of Arts in Social Science), gyebamutikira mu 1974. Yamala neyegata ku Kennedy School of Government ku Harvard University, mu Cambridge, Massachusetts mu gwanga ly'Amerika. Yatikirwa diguli ey'okubiri mu kudukanya emirimo gy'olukale (Master of Public Administration). emisomo gye ku Harvard yasasulilwa ekibina  ky'abakunganira awamu (Fellowship) okuva eHarvard Institute for International Development.

Gyenvudde'we mu kukola 
Okuva 1981 okutusa 1984, yali akola ng'omuwandisi wa kampuni w'ekitongole kya Uganda ekikwasaganya eby'okusima ebintu eby'omuwendo ekya ''Uganda Mining Corporation'.

Okuva 1986 okutusa 1996, yawereza ng'omubaka wa palamenti ya Uganda. Mu 1988, yalondebwa okuba minista w'ensonga z'amambuka ga Uganda (State Minister for Northern Uganda), ekyamwetagisa okutandika okubera e' Gulu, ekibuga ekikulu mu mambuka ga Uganda.

Yawebwa omulimo gw'okuumatiza abayekera ba  Lord's Resistance Army (LRA) okuusa wansi eby'okulwanyisa, ng'eby'okubalwannyisa ne mundu biremerede Gavumenti. Bigombe yatandikawo enkwatagana ne ssabayekera wa LRA leader Joseph Kony mu sebo aseka wa 1993. Mu 1993, yalondebwa nga munna Yuganda omukyala ow'omwaka, kulw'amanyi geyateka mukumalawo obutabanguko. 

Enteseganya zino zamala nezigana mu 1994 okulwana nekudamu. Kyatwala emyaka kumi okudamu okulowoza ku kuzawo emirembe.

Ng'amaze emyaka kumi mu palamenti, okuva 1986 okutusa 1996 yalemerelwa okuwangula ekifo ky'omubaka wa Gulu Municipality awo nava mu by'okukolera Gavumenti. Mu 2011, yada mu by'obufuzi bwe yawangula ekifo ky'omubaka omukyala owa Disitulikiti ye Amuru n'gali ku kakonge k'ekibina ky'ebyobufuzi ekya National Resistance Movement (NRM).

Mu 1997, ng'amaze okutikirwa ku Harvard, yawebwa omulimo ku Banka yensi yoona (World Bank) mu  Washington, DC, ng'akola nakabinja akavunanizibwa ku mbera ng'olutalo luwedde (Senior Social Scientist with the Post-Conflict Unit). Yamala nawereza nga, kakensa eyebuzibwako owekiwayi kya Banka eno ekivunnizibwa ku kukuma ennkolagana n'abantu wamu n'oku kulakulanya omuntu. Mu 1999 ne 2000, Bigombe yali awa amagaezi g'obukugu eli Carter Center mu kutabaganya Gavumenti za' Yuganda ne Sudan.

Mu Mukutulansanja wa 2004, mu kitta bantu kya ''Barlonyo massacre'', Bigombe yaava ku Banka yensi yoona nakomawo mu Uganda okugezako okuzawo enkolagana y'okuleta obutebenkevu. Okuva Mugulansigo wa 2004 okutusa 2005, Bigombe yeyali omutabaganya owokuntiko wakati w'abayekera ba Lord's Resistance Army wamu ne Gavumenti, nga yatekamu neku'sente zze ng'omuntu okugula ebbimu ku byali byetagisa okulaba nti enteseganya zino zibelawo . Olukkiko olwasembayo lwabawo ng'enaku zomwezi 20 Kafuumuulampawo 2005 twelwavamu ebyali bisubirwa, Wabula okutabaganya kuno Bigombe  kweyagezako okukola kutunulirwa ng'okwatekawo omusingi  gw'entesaganya za 2006–2007 ezzali mu Juba, okwakulemberwamu Gavumenti ya South Sudan. Entesaganya zino zaagwaa butaaka oluvanyuma lwa Joseph Kony okugana okusa omukono ku ndagano y'eddembe ku ddakkika esembayo.

Mu 2006, yadayo mu Amerika nawereza ng'omukungu (Senior Fellow) wa US Institute of Peace mu Washington DC). Yamala nalondebwa ng'omukungu owenjawulo owa,  Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars. Mu 2007, yawangula engule ya ''Peacemakers in Action'' okuva mu Tanenbaum Center for Interreligious Understanding.

Yalondebwa nga Ssentebe w'ekitongole kya Gavumenti ekidukanya ebyamuwulire ne technologiya ekya (National Information and Technology Authority in Uganda (NITAU) mu 2009. 

Mu Muzigo wa 2011,Bigombe Yalondebwa President Yoweri Museveni okuba minista w'eby'amazi, ekifo kyeyasigalamu paaka sebo aseka wa 2014, lweyalekulila ekifo kino nagenda okukola ne Banka yensi yoona.

ebimukwatako ebirala 
Betty Bigombe yali mukyala w'omukungu/ambasada wa Yuganda e Japan. Alina abaana babiri; Pauline ne Emmanuel. Asobola okwogera enimmi nnya(4) okuli; Olucholi, Oluzungu, oluswayili wamu n'olu'Japan.

Ebijulizo

Annet Katusiime Mugisha mubaka omukyala akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Bushenyi mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda) olw'ekkuminoolumu.

Ebimukwatako n'okusoma kwe 
Annet Katusiime Mugisha  yazaalibwa mu mwaka gwa 1974 mu kitundu kya Kaantunda ekisangibwa mu ggombolola ya Bumbaire mu ddisitulikiti ya Bushenyi.

Annet Mugisha yamaliriza ddiguli ye esooka mu Social Development and Counseling ku Uganda Matyrs University, Nkozi. Mu mwaka guno ogwa 2021 yatandise ddiguli ye ey'okubiri eya masters in Business Administration (MBA) ku Nkozi University.

Emirimu gy'akoze

Egy'obutendeke 
Muky. Annet Katusiime Mugisha yasomesaako mu ssomero lya pulayimale. Akozeeko ne ku mirimu gy'okufumba emmere ey'oku mikolo.

Mu ngeri y'emu, ye omu ku baddukanya ekitongole kya Bamugisha Community Welfare Ltd, ekitongole ky'obwannakyewa ekiyambyeko okukulaakulanya ppuloojekiti ez'enjawulo awatali busosoze bwonna.

Egy'ebyobufuzi 
Katusiime Mugisha  munnakibiina kya National Resistance Movement(NRM). Yayingira ebyobufuzi mu kalulu ka 2021 n'awangula Mary Karooro Okurut mu kamyufu ka NRM n'oluvannyuma n'amegga abantu abalala basatu mu kulonda ababaka abakiikirira ebitundu eby'enjawulo mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda) okwaliwo ng'ennaku z'omwezi 14 Ogusooka, 2021.

Obulamu obw'omunda 
Muky. Annet Katusiime Mugisha ne Eng. Dr. Silver Mugisha bafumbo okuva mu mwaka gwa 1994 era ng'omwaka 2021 we gutuukidde ng'alina abaana bataano. Annet Katusiime Mugisha kkansala omutendeke ate era musigansimbi.

Annet Katusiime Mugisha mutuuze mu ddisitulikiti ya Bushenyi mu Uganda.

Ebijulizo

Hellen Auma Wandera ye mubaka omukyala omulonde okukiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Busia mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga olw'ekkuminoolumu.

Ebimukwatako n'okusoma kwe 
Hellen Auma Wandera yazaalibwa mu ddisitulikiti ya Busia. Hellen Auma Wandera sekendule yagisomera ku St. Peters Naalya (Spena International) n'oluvannyuma n'agenda ku Kyambogo University okweyongerayo mu byemisomo.

Olugendo lw'ebyobufuzi 
She munnakibiina kya National Resistance Movement(NRM). Yawangula defeated Nina Nekesa, Fiona Nakku, Nabwire Sharon Veron Namumayi, Esther Busingye Wafula, Grace Nyakecho, Teddy Auma ne Lilian Taaka mu kamyufu ka NRM ak'ababaka mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga akaakubibwa mu mwaka gwa 2020.. Ye yaddira Jane Nabulindo Kwoba mu bigere ng'omubaka omukyala akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Busia mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga oluvannyuma lw'akalulu ka bonna aka 2021 mu Uganda.

Obulamu obw'omunda 
We tutuukidde mu Gwokuna gwa 2021 nga Hellen Auma Wandera si mufumbo.

Ebijulizo

Ndamira Catherine Atwikiire (eyazaalibwa nga 13 Ogwomunaana 1977) munnayuganda ate era mubaka mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga. Yalondebwa okuba omubaka omukyala akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Kabale mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga  wansi w'ekibiina ekiri mu buyinza ekya National Resistance Movement.

Emirimu gy'akoze 
Mu kaseera kano, Atwikiire mmemba ku bukiiko bubiri: akakiiko k'ebyembalirira n'ebyenfuna n'akakiiko k'ebyobulamu. Yaddukanyaako ebyensimbi mu kitongole kya VIDAS Engineering Services Co. Ltd. okuva mu mwaka gwa 2010 okutuuka mu 2015.

Mu mwaka gwa 2019, yeenyigira mu nteekateeka y'okusomesa abantu mu munisipaali ya Kabale era n'akuutira abasiraamu okusomesa abaana baabwe okusobola okufufuggaza enkulaakulana ey'ekiboggwe mu ggwanga.

Ebijulizo

Janet Kainembabazi Museveni (n'erya Kataaha, yazaalibwa mu Gwomukaaga nga 24, 1948). Munnayuganda, Munnabyabufuzi era abadde Maama wa Uganda (First Lady of Uganda) okuva mu 1986. Yafumbirwa Pulezidenti Yoweri Museveni, gwe yazaalamu abaana bana. Abadde Minisita w'Ebyenjigiriza n'Ebyemizannyo mu Kabineeti ya Uganda okuva nga 6 Ogwomukaaga 2016. Yaweerezaako nga Minisita ow'ensonga z'e Kalamoja okuva nga 27 Ogwokutaano 2011 okutuusa nga 6 Ogwomukaaga 2016. Era yaweerezaako nga mmemba wa Paalamenti ya Uganda ng'akiikirira Essaza ly'e Ruhaama mu Disitulikiti y'e Ntungamo,wakati wa 2011 ne 2016. Yafulumya akatabo ka gyenvudde we ke yatuuma, My Life's Journey, mu 2011.

Obulamu bwe obwasooka n'obufumbo bwe 
Janet Kainembabazi Kataaha yazaalibwa mu ssaza ly'e Kajara, erisangibwa mu Disitulikiti y'e Ntungamo.  nga kitaawe ye Mw. Edward Birori ne nnyina ye Mukyl. Mutesi. Yatandika emisomo gye mu Kyamate Primary School, n'asomera ne mu Bweranyangi Girls' Senior Secondary School in Uganda 

Janet Museveni yagendako mu buwaŋŋanguse mu 1971, mu kiseera Idi Amin we yawambira Gavumenti ya Milton Obote ng'agiwambisa amagye. Yafumbirwa Yoweri Museveni mu Gwomunaana,1973. Gavumenti ya  Idi Amin bwe yamaamulwako mu 1979, yakomawo mu Uganda ng'ava e Tanzania gye yali yawaŋŋangukira ne bba.

Mu February wa 1981 Yoweri Museveni mwe yalangirira olutalo lw'ekiyeekera ng'alwanyisa Gavumenti ya Pulezidenti Obote eyaliko, Janet Museveni n'abaana be naddamu okufuluma eggwanga ne basengukira e Nairobi, Kenya, gye baawangaalira okutuuka mu 1983. Mu 1983, beeyongerayo mu kibuga Gothenburg ekya Sweden, ne babeera eyo okutuusa mu Gwokutaano, 1986, lwe baavaayo nga wayise emyezi ena ng'eggye lya Museveni erya National Resistance Army liwambye ekibuga kya Uganda ekikulu ekya Kampala.

Ebyemirimu gye 
Janet Museveni ye mutandisi w'ekibiina kya Uganda Women's Effort to Save Orphans (UWESO), mu myaka gya 1986, gye yagamba nti  yakikola asinziira ku mbeera gye yayitamu mu buwaŋŋanguse. Yeenyigira mu kaweefube w'okulwanyisa Obulwadde bwa Siriimu (HIV/AIDS) mu Uganda mu myaka gy'ekyenda (1990s). Batta omukago nga batambulira wamu ne Paasita Martin Ssempa mu kubunya enjiri y'okwekuuma obuteega ng'enkola esinga mu kwewala Siriimu mu Uganda.

Mu Gwekkuminoogumu / November 2005, yalangirira nti yali yeegwanyiza ekifo ky'Obwammemba bwa Paalamenti eky'essaza ly'e Ruhaama mu era mu kulonda kwa bonna okwa 2006 . Yavuganya ku kifo kino ng'avuganya ne kandideeti w'ekibiina ky'ebyobufuzi ekyaForum for Democratic Change, Augustine Ruzindana, era Janet yawangula ekifo kino nga tafunye kuvuganyizibwa kwamaanyi. Yaddamu okulondebwa mu kifo kye kimu mu 2011 n'akimalamu emyaka emirala etaano.

Nga 16 Ogwokubiri, 2009, Janet Museveni bba (Pulezidenti Museveni) yamulonda nga Minisita omubeezi ow'ensonga z'e Karamoja.

Nga 27 Ogwokutaano 2011, yayongezebwa ekisanja n'ayongera okuweereza nga Minisita Ow'ensonga z'e Karamoja.

Nga 6 Ogwomukaaga 2016, bba bwe yaddamu okulondebwa nga Pulezidenti wa Uganda yalonda mukazi we ono mu kifo kya Minisita ow'Ebyenjigiriza n'Ebyemizannyo.

Abaana be 
Abaana abazaalibwa Janet ne Yoweri Museveni mwe muli:

 Muhoozi Kainerugaba - Yazaalibwa mu 1974, ali ku ddaala lya Major General mu ggye lya Uganda erya UPDF era ye muduumizi w'eggye erikuuma Pulezidenti w'eggwanga erya Special Forces.
 Natasha Karugire - Yazaalibwa mu 1976, wa bya misono (Fashion designer and consultant). Yafumbirwa Edwin Karugire. Muyambi wa Pulezidenti wa Uganda.
 Patience Rwabwogo - Yazaalibwa mu 1978, Paasita w'ekkanisa ya Covenant Nations Church, esangibwa e Buziga mu Kampala. Yafumbirwa Odrek Rwabwogo.
 Diana Kamuntu - Yazaalibwa mu 1980, era yafumbirwa Geoffrey Kamuntu.

Aisha Sekindi (eyazaalibwa nga 4 Ogwekkumineebiri 1970) munnayuganda, musomesa ate era munnamateeka. Okuva mu Gwokuna gwa 2020 aweerezza ng'omubaka omukyala omulonde akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Kalungu mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda) olw'ekkumi.  Ku ludda lw'ebyobufuzi ali mu kibiina kya National Resistance Movement era nga ky'ekibiina kye yajjiramu mu kalulu ka bonna aka 2016, alyoke emegge Aisha Naluyati Waligo.

Ebimukwatako n'okusoma kwe 
Aisha Sekindi yasomerako ku Kyato Muslim Primary School n'avaayo mu mwaka gwa 1984 okweyunga ku Kadugala Secondary School gye yamalira siniya ey'okuna (n'afuna Uganda Certificate of Education) mu mwaka gwa 1988. Mu mwaka gwa 1995, Aisha Sekindi yafuna satifikeeti y'obusomesa ku  Kibuli Teacher Training College.

Emirimu gy'akoze 
Wadde nga Aisha Sekindi yasooka kuba mumyuka wa mukulu w'essomero lya Saint Kizito Primary School, Lwengo (1997-2001), yawangula ekifo ky'obwakkansala LCV owa Lwabenge era n'aweerezaako nga ssaabawandiisi w'ebyentondwa mu ddisitulikiti ya Masaka okuva mu mwaka gwa 2001 okutuuka mu 2007.

Nga tannafuuka munnamateeka, Aisha Sekindi yaweerezaako ng'omumyuka w'omubaka wa ppulezidenti mu ddisitulikiti ya Lira okuva mu 2013 okutuuka mu 2014. Nga tannaweereza mu ddisitulikiti ya Lira, yaweerezaako mu kifo kyekimu mu ddisitulikiti ya Tororo (2011-2013) ne mu ddisitulikiti ya Kamuli (2007-2011). Wakati wa 2010 ne 2011, yaweerezaako ng'omubaka wa ppulezidenti mu ddisitulikiti ya Buyende.

Nga munnamateeka mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda) olw'ekkumi, Aisha Sekindi ali mu kibiina kya Uganda Women Parliamentary Association (UWOPA) ate era nga mmemba mu kakiiko k'ebyobulimi.

Grace Akello (yazaalibwa mu 1950) Munnayuganda Omutontomi, omuwandiisi w'emboozi empanvu, omuwandiisi w'ennyimba ennansi era munnabyabufuzi. Ye ambasada wa Uganda  mu nsi ya India.

Obuto bwe n'ebyensoma 
Dinah Grace Akello Muteeso (Iteso),era yazaalibwa mu bitundu ebiriraanye ekibuga Soroti, ekisangibwa mu Buvanjuba bwa Uganda. Yasoma bya kuweereza na kuyamba bantu (Social Administration and Social Work) nga Ddiguli eno yagisomera ku Makerere University mu Kampala. Mu 1979, yabeerako e Tanzania bwe yali adduse ekibambulira kya Gavumenti ya Pulezidenti Idi Amin era yaliyo ng'omunoonyi w'obubudamu.

Emirimu gye 
Yakolako ng'omukuŋŋaanya w'akatabo ka maagaziini akaafulumiranga e Kenya n'e Tanzania mu kiseera nga tannagenda Bungereza. Bwe yatuuka e Bungereza awo mu myaka gy'ekinaana (1980s) yafuuka omumuka w'omukuŋŋaanya w'ekitongole ky'amawanga agaaliko mu luse lwa Bungereza ekya Commonwealth Secretariat. Ekifo kino Akello yakirimu okuva mu 1983 okutuuka mu 1990.

Ebyobufuzi 
Mu 1990, Grace Akello yadda ku butaka e Uganda n'akola akakiiko akaaluubirira okutaasa Abateeso (Teso People) abaali bagobwa ku ttaka lyabwe kw'ossa okuttibwa ku mulembe gwa Idi Amin Dada. Akakiiko kano kaaliwo okutuusa mu mwaka gwa 1996. Mu 1996, yafuuka Omubaka wa Paalamenti ya Uganda era mu 1999 yalondebwa okubeera Minisita w'ekikula ky'abantu, abakozi n'enkulaakulana.

Okuva mu 1999 okutuuka mu 2006, yali Minisita mu Kabineeti y'eggwanga Uganda. Yali Minisita w'obwegassi n'okutereka /  Microfinance Initiatives okuva mu 1999 okutuuka mu 2003, era n'afuuka Minisita w'Amambuka ga Uganda okuva mu 2003 okutuusa mu 2006.

Grace Akello yafuuka Ambasada wa Uganda mu Italy, ng'abeera mu kibuga Rome oluvannyuma n'afuuka Ambasada wa Uganda mu India ng'atuula mu kibuga New Delhi.

Litulica 
Mu 1992, yawandiika ekitontome kye yatuuma "Encounter"(Okweŋŋanga). Era ayongera n'agamba nti oluyimba lwe olwa My Barren Song lwavuganya mu mpaka za Margaret Busby's Daughters of Africa, era nassibwa mu ttuluba ly'abakazi abawandiisi abakuukuutivu mu Afrika.

Ebijulizo

Cissy Dionizia Namujju (yazaalibwa nga 15 Ogwomusanvu 1977) Munnayuganda nga mmemba wa Paalamenti ate omukugu mu byakompyuta. We bwatuukira u Gwokusatu gwa 2021, yali aweereza ng'Omubaka omukazi omulonde akiikirira Disitulikiti y'e Lwengo  mu Paalamenti ya Uganda ey'ekkumineemu. Mu byobufuzi, ali mu kibiina kya National Resistance Movement era nga ku kkaadi yaakyo kwe yavuganyiza mu kulonda kwa bonna okwaliwo mu 2021. Cissy era yali mmemba mu Paalamenti ey'ekkumi era ng'ali wansi w'ekibiina ky'ebyobufuzi kye kimu ekya NRM.

Okusoma kwe 
Cissy Dionizia Namujju yatuula S4 ye mu 2005 n'atuula ne S6 mu 2007 ng'ali mu ssomero lya Modern Secondary School.  Alina Dipulooma mu byatekinologiya gye yasomera mu ttendekero lya APTECH mu (2010).

Emirimu 
Cissy Namujju yaliko akulira ekitongole kya AGOA Girls (2002-2003) nga tannafuuka omukunzi w'amaka g'Obwapulezidenti mu byobufuzi (2003 - 2015). Okuva mu 2016 okutuusa leero, abadde mmemba wa Paalamenti. Mu Paalamenti ey'ekkumi aweereza ku kakiiko akalondoola ensonga za 'enkolagana ya Uganda n'amawanga amalala wamu n'akakiiko ka Paalamenti aka ssaayansi ne tekinologiya.

Ebimukwatako 
Si mufumbo. Ebintu by'anyumirwa mu biseera bye eby'eddembe mulimu: Ebyemizannyo n'okusoma ebitabo. Cissy ayagala nnyo okuyamba n'okufaayo eri abakadde, bannamwandu , bamulekwa. Okutumbula ennima ey'omulembe n'okusomesa abantu ku bintu ebyomugaso ebibakwatako.

Hanifa Kawooya (yazaalibwa nga 21Gatonnya /January,1957) Munnayuganda, munnabyabufuzi era mukulembeze. Mubaka Omukazi mu Paalamenti akiikirira Disitulikiti y'e Sembabule. Kawooya ali mu kibiina ky'ebyobufuzi ekiri mu buyinza ekya National Resistance Movement (NRM).

Gyava n'ebyobuyigirize 
Mu 2004, yatikkirwa Ddiguli ye esooka mu by'enkulaakulana eya Bachelors Degree of Arts in Development Studies mu Nkumba University. Oluvannyuma mu 2007 yatiikirwa Ddiguli eyookubiri (Masters) ekywata ku nkwatagana ez'amawanga ag'enjawulo eyitibwa Master of International Relations and Diplomacy nga yagisomera mu Yunivaasite y'emu.

Emirimu n'olugendo lwe olw'ebyobufuzi 
Okuva mu 1993-1995, yali mukiise mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga Uganda olufuzi olwa National Assembly. Wakati wa 1998-2002, ye yali akulira eby'empuliziganya ku lukiiko lw'abakyala olwa National Women Council. Okuva mu 1980 okutuuka mu 1992, yaweebwa omulimu era n'aweereza nga kitunzi wa kkampuni y'ennyonyi eya Uganda Airlines n'eya Zambia Airways. Okuva mu 2016 okutuusa leero, abadde mubaka mu Paalamenti ya Africa eya Pan African Parliament. Hanifa era yakolako ng'omuwanika w'akabondo k'ababaka ba Paalamenti ab'ekibiina kye eky'ebyobufuzi mw'ali ekya National Resistance Movement. Era yaliko Omukubiriza w'olikiiko lwa Disitulikiti y'e Sembabule. Yakolako mu kitongole ky'eggwanga eky'emisola ekya   Uganda Revenue Authority ng'akola nga Senior Principal Revenue Officer mu 2001. Yakolako ng'omumyuka wa RDC (Deputy Resident District Commissioner) owa Disitulikiti y'e Rakai. Okuva mu 2001 okutuusa leero, abadde Mmemba mu Paalamenti ya Uganda.

 Mmemba ku kakiiko ka Paalamenti ak'ensonga z'ebweru.

Irene Nafuna Muloni Munnayuganda nya Yinginiya wa masannyalaze, munnabizinensi era munnabyabufuzi. Muwi wa magezi omugundiivu owa Pulezidenti wa Ugandan, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. Yaweerezaako nga Minisita w'amasannyalaze n'ebyomugagga eby'omuttaka mu Kabineeti ya Uganda okuva nga 27 Ogwokutaano okutuuka mu 2019. Ekifo kino ek'Obwaminisita yakisigalamu n'oluvannyuma lw'okulonda kwa bonna okwa 2016. Yaweereza ng'Omubaka omukazi owa Paalamenti omulonde owa Disitulikiti y'e Bulambuli okuva mu 2011 okutuuka mu 2016 lwe yawangulwa eyali amuvuganya era eyeesimbawo ku bwannamunigina; Sarah Wekomba. Kyokka oluvannyuma yaddamu okuwangula ekifo kino mu kulonda kwa bonna okwa 2021.https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/special-reports/elections/muloni-back-to-lead-bulambuli-nrm-party-wins-big-in-tororo--3261662

Gy'ava n'ebyokusoma kwe 
Yazaalibwa nga 18 Ogwekkuminoogumu 1960, mu kitundu kati ekiyitibwa Disitulikiti y'e Bulambuli. Yasomera mu ssomero lya Budadiri Girls' Primary School nga tanneeyunga ku Gayaza High School. Mu 1982, yeegatta ku Makerere University, nga ye Yunivaasite esingayo obukulu mu mawanga agali Ebuvanjuba bwe Afrika (East Africa), n'asomerayo obwayinginiya. Mu 1986, yatikkirwa ddiguli ye mu by'amasannyalaze eya Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSc.E.Eng). Oluvannyuma yatikkirwa Didguli ye eyookubiri mu kuddukanya Buzinensi eya Master of Business Administration (MBA), okuva mu Capella University e Minneapolis, Minnesota, mu ggwanga lya America. Era akola nga Certified Public-Private Partnership Specialist, nga yakkirizibwa aba Institute for Public-Private Partnerships ng'akola n'aba the Water, Engineering and Development Centre (WEDC) okuva mu Loughborough University.

Emirimu 
Okuva mu 2002 okutuusa mu 2011, Irene Muloni yali akola ng'akulira ekitongole ekibunyisa amasannyalaze mu Uganda ekya Uganda Electricity Distribution Company Limited (UEDCL). Mu 2011, yavuganya mu kulonda kwa bonna okwaliwo era n'awangula entebe y'omubaka omukazi owa Disitulikiti y'e Bulambuli mu Paalamenti ya Uganda ey'omwenda. Nga 27 Ogwokutaano 2011, Yalondebwa Pulezidenti Yoweri Museveni okubeera Minisita w'amasannyalaze n'ebyobugagga eby'omuttaka. Mu kifo kino yali adda mu bigere bya Hilary Onek, eyali alondeddwa nga Minisita w'ensonga ez'ebweru. Mu nkyukakyuka ezaakolebwa mu Kabineeti ezaalabgirirwa nga 6 Ogwomukaaga 2016, Muloni yasigala mu kifo kino n'akiweerezaamu ekisanja ekirala kya myaka etaano.

Janat Balunzi Mukwaya Munnabyabufuzi era eyawummula ogw'okuvuga ennyonyi mu ggye ly'eggwanga lya Uganda. Mu kiseera kino muwi wa magezi eri Pulezidenti Museven. Yaweerezaako nga Minisita wa guno na guli mu ofiisi ya Ssaabaminisita wa Uganda okuva nga 16 Ogwokubiri 2009 okutuusa nga 27 Ogwokutaano 2011.  Era yaweerezaako nga Minisita w'ekikula ky'abantu n'abakozi okuva nga 6 Ogwomukaaga 2016 okutuuka mu Gwekkumineebiri 2019. Yaweerezaako nga Minisita w'ebyobusuubuzi n'amakolero okuva mu Gwomukaaga, 2006 okutuusa mu Gwokubiri, 2009. Mu Gwokutaano, 2011, yasalawo okulekulira ebyobufuzi okumala akaseera era n'asikizibwa Kiddu Makubuya. Era yaweerezaako ng'Omubaka wa Paalamenti omulonde owa Konsituwensi ya Mukono ey'obukiikaddyo (Mukono South Constituency), mu Disitulikiti y'e Mukono, okuva mu 2006 okutuuka lwe yalekulira ebyobufuzi mu 2011.

Ebyafaayo bye n'okusoma kwe 
Mukwaya yazaalibwa nga 12 Ogwekumineebiri, 1951 mu Disitulikiti y'e Mukono. Yasoma byabufuzi n'okukulembera abantu mu Makerere University mu bbanga wakati wa 1971 ne 1975, n'atikkirwa Ddiguli eya Bachelor of Arts. Wakati wa 1975 ne 1981, yakolako ng'omulamuzi ow'eddaala eryokubiri. Mu 1981 yeegatta ku kibinja ekyali eky'abayeekera ekya National Resistance Army (NRA) ng'omulwanyi. Yalinnya n'atuuka ku ddaala ly'Obwakapiteeni mu ggye eryo erya NRA. Alina ne Ddiguli eyookubiri eya Master of Arts degree in public policy and management gye yasomera mu University of London.

Olugendo lwe olw'ebyobufuzi 
Eggye lya NRA bwelyawamba obuyiza mu 1986, Mukwaya yalandebwa nga Diyirekita w'ensonga z'abakyala mu minisitule y'ekikula ky'abantu n'abakozi nga yabeera mu kifo kino okutuusa mu 1990. Mu 1994, yalondebwa ng'omuwandiisi ow'ekyama ow'Omumyuka wa Pulezidenti wa Uganda n'aweereza mu kifo kino okutuusa mu 1995. Wakati wa 1995 ne 1996, Mukwaya ye yali Minisita ow'ensonga Z'akanyigo k'e Luweero mu ofiisi ya Pulezidenti wa Uganda. Wakati wa 1996 ne 2001, yaweereza nga Minisita ow'ekikula ky'abantu, abakozi n'enkulaakulana.

Yafuuka Ssaabawolereza wa Gavumenti era Minisita w'essiga eddamuzi n'ensonga za Ssemateeka mu 2004 n'aweereza mu kifo ekyo okutuuka mu 2005. Mu 2005, yakyusibwa n'afuulibwa Minisita W'ebyobulimi, Obulunzi n'obuvubi n''aweereza mu kifo ekyo okutuuka mu 2006.

Mu 2006, yalondebwa okubeera mmemba wa Paalamenti ng'avuganyiza ku kkaadi ya National Resistance Movement olwo n'atandika okukiikirira abantu ba Konsityuwensi ya Mukono South. Mu mwaka gwe gumu, yalondebwa okubeeera Minisita w'ebyobulambuzi, Ebyobusuubuzi n'amakolero nga mu kifo kino yabeeramu okutuusa lwe yaddamu okulondebwa okubeera Minisita wa Gunonaguli mu Ofiisi ya Ssabaminisita wa Uganda. . Mu Gatonnya /January wa 2010, amawulire gaafuluma nti yali si waakuddamu kuvuganya ku kifo kya Paalamenti mu kulonda kwa bonna okwali kubindabinda mu mwaka ogwali guddako - 2011.

Akomawo 
Mu Gwomukaaga 2016, yaggyibwa mu kuwummula bwe yalondebwa nga Minisita w'ekikula ky'abantu, abakozi n'enkulaakulana. Obumu ku buvunaanyizibwa bwe yalina okusookerako nga Minsita w'abakozi eyali alondeddwa mu kifo kino omulundi owokubiri, kwali kuteesa ku nsonga z'okutwala abakozi mu Bwakabaka bwa Jordan bafuneyo emirimu.

Victoria Sekitoleko Yali Minisita w'Ebyobulimi mu Gavumenti ya Uganda, yabeera mu kifo kino okuva mu 1986 okutuuka mu 1995. Yaliko akiikirira ekitongole ky'emmere n'ebyobulimi eky'ensi yonna mu mawanga nga China, Mongolia, n'e South Korea (okuva mu Gwekkumi 2006 – Gwokuna 2011)  Era yakolako ng'akiikirira ekitongole ky'amawanga amagatte mu ekitongole ky'ebyemmere n'ebyobulimi eri Omukago gw'amawanga ga Afrika ekya African Union (AU) mu Ethiopia. Yakoalako ne mu kitongole kya Economic Community for Africa (ECA) (2005–2006). Ye yali akiikirira  FAO mu bitundu by'Obuvanjuba n'Amaserengeta ga Afrika ng'abeera mu kibuga Harare ekya Zimbabwe.(1995–2004).  Gye buvuddeko yalondebwa ng'omu ku batuula ku bboodi ya kkampuni erunda enkoko ku mutindo ogw'ensi yonna eya Biyinzika Poultry International Limited (BPIL) mu Gwomukaaga, 2017. 

Sekitoleko yasomera mu Makerere University mu Kampala, gye yasomera Ddiguli mu Byobulimi eya BSc in Agriculture majoring in Farm Management and Extension (1970–1973). Mu 1983, yasomayo satifikeeti endala mu byobulimi ng'eri ku kuzuula n'okuddukanya polojekiti z'ebyobulimi mu ttendekero lta Eastern and Southern Africa Management Institute (ESAMI). Mu 2003 Yasomayo satifikeeti endala bwe yali e Zimbabwe, nga yo eyitibwa Certificate in Systemic Counselling nga yagisomera mu ttendekero lya Zimbabwe Institute of Systemic Counseling. Mu 2004, yeetaba mu ttabamiruka w'ebyobulimi eyatuumibwa Limpopo University RSA (in conjunction with University of southern Hampshire USA) n'afunaye Satifikeeti eya Micro Enterprise and Development.

Bwe yali mu Paalamenti, Sekitoleko yali mmemba  National Resistance Council (NRC).

Victoria Sekitoleko is currently Chairperson of the governing board of Uganda Agribusiness Alliance. The purpose of the Uganda Agribusiness Business Alliance is to unite all those involved in the industry to best optimize their ability to profitably and sustainably pursue the many global opportunities that present themselves as part of competing in the world's largest industry.

Mu 2013, Victoria Sekitoleko yeegatta ku kibiina ky'abakyala aabakozi ba bizinensi ekya Business and Professional Women Kampala (BWP). Era yeegatta ne ku kibiina kya Uganda Women Entrepreneurs Association Limited (UWEAL) mu mwaka gwe gumu.

Mu 2010 Victoria Sekitoleko yatandikawo ekitongole ka Uganda Community Cultural Center. Nga'ayita mu kibiina kino agenze asomesa abantu mu byobulimi n'okusomesa abantu okwogera mu bantu. Ofiisi ze ziri ku Victoria House e Bukoto nga zitunudde me ddwaliro lya Kadic Hospital. Yateekawo omukutu guno n'ekigendererwa eky'okuyigiriza abantu okubeera aboogezi ab'omulembe. Okutuusa kati ateeka nnyo obudde bwe mu kutendeka abantu butya bwe boogera oba bwe bayinza okufuuka aboogezi abalungi. Abateerawo ekyanya we bafunira emiramwa ne bakubaganya ebirowoozo. Ku mukutu guno oguyitibwa 'speakers forum' abantu ab'engeri ezitali zimu baku ng'aana ne bawaanyisiganya amagezi n'okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga ezikwata ku bulamu bwabwe.

Mu kiseerakye bwe yabanga akiikirira Uganda e China, Sekitoleko yasikirizibwa era ne yeegomba empisa z'Abachina ng'ayagala nnyo okutambulako n'okunyuma bya'alabye eyo gy'aba eyise.

Ng'ayita mu kibiina kya Speakers Forum, Victoria Sekitoleko yateekawo ne ayibulale omuli ebitabo eby'enjawulo abavubuka abato bye basoma ne bongera okunyweza empisa y'okusoma n'okuba  abamanyi. Emu ku layibulale zino eri Bukoto, ku nkingizzi z'ekibuga Kampala.

Layibulale eno ey'e Bukoto era erimu n'ebitabo ebisomesa ku mbeera y'Abachina omuli obuwangwa bwabwe wamu n'obw'e Uganda. Layibulale endala ziri Budondo, Namulesa, Wanyange, n'eri ku Life Skills Center, e Bugembe abayizi ba Sinia gye bagenda okukoocingibwa mu biseera by'oluwummula. Omukyala ono era ayambyeko mu kutongoza layibulale endala nnyingi, okugeza eya Uphill Nursery and Primary School e Bugobya mu Disitulikitiy'e Jinja , Namaganga, Kigalagala community libraries mu ggombolola y'e Busede - Jinja, e Bugodi mu Disitulikiti y'e Mayuge, e Kasambira mu Distulikiti y'e Kamuli n'awalala.

Abeera Ntinda mu maka ge. Ekirooto kye kwe kukulaakulanya abantu mu mbeera z'obulamu zonna n'okubazzaamu amaanyi okulaba nga batangaaza ebiseera byabwe eby'omumaaso.

Hanifa Nabukeera munnayuganda ate era munnabbizineesi. Mu kaseera kano, Nabukeera ye mubaka omukyala omulonde akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Mukono mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda). Ebimukwatako 
Hanifa Nabukeera yazaalibwa mu ddisitulikiti ya Mukono, ddisitulikiti esangibwa mu kitundu ky'omu masekkati ga Uganda. Yayingira ebyobufuzi mu mwaka gwa 2009. Yeesimbawokko ku kifo ky'omubaka omukyala akiikirira ddisitulikiti ya Mukono mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga emirundi ebiri ng'awangulwa: mu mwaka gwa 2011 n'ogwa 2016. Mu kalulu ka bonna aka 2016 yakwata kifo kyakubiri naye kaakano ye mubaka omukyala omulonde akiikirira disitulikiti ya Mukono mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga (Uganda) olw'ekkuminoolumu era ng'ali mu kibiina kya NUP.  Mu mwezi Gwomwenda, NUP yakakasa Nabukeera ng'omuntu eyali agenda okukwata bendera y'ekibiina mu kalulu ka bonna aka 2021 era nga mu kutuuka ku ekyo yamegga abantu bangi abaali beegwanyiza okukwatira ekibiina kya NUP bendera ku kifo ekyo gamba nga Lydia Namayengo.

Ebijulizo

Corbin Bleu Reivers (* 21 Gwakubiri 1989, Brooklyn) kiri munnakatemba omusajja, United States ne Italie.

Bannakatemba

Guno gwe gumu ku mizannyo egizannyibwa mu Buganda. Omuzannyo guno guzannyiwa bawala. Abawandiika ku byafaayo by’omuzannyo guno bagamba nti gwaggyibwa mu ogwo ogumanyiddwa ng’ogw’ensero, basketball mu mwaka gwa 1981. Amateeka g’omuzannyo gw’ensero gaakyusibwamu ne bafunamu omuzannyo omuggya ogw’okubaka omupiira. 

Mu kusooka omuzannyo guno gwakkiriziwa ng’ogusaanira okuzannyibwa abawala/abakyala bokka. Okuvuganya era kwatandika okubaawo mu mawanga ag’enjawulo. Wabula nti okuvuganya wakati w’amawanga kwasooka kukaluba olw’okuba nti amateeka agafuga omuzannyo guno gaasooka kuba ga njawulo. Amateeka agafuga omuzannyo guno gaatereezebwa mu mwaka gwa 1960 era okuvuganya wakati w’amawanga ag’enjawulo kwatandika mu 1963.

Enzannya y’okubaka omupiira
Omuzannyo guno guzannyirwa mu kisaawe ekikolebwa nga kya njawulo ku birala byonna era kyo kibeera kya muzannyo guno gwokka. Kirina ebipimpo byakyo ebirina okugobererwa nga kikolebwa era ne goolo zennyini wamu n’obutimba obuteebebwamu nabyo birina ebipimo eby’olugerero ebimanyiddwa wonna. Omuzannyo guno gumu ku ogwo ogwetaaga omuntu alina omubiri omulamu obulungi kubanga gulimu okukozesa obwangu n’obukugu ebisinziira ku kudduka (okuddusa akapiira), okubuuka (okubuuka n’akapiira baleme kukakuggyako oba ng’ogenda okuteeba), okukasuka n’okubaka akapiira.

Abazannyi babeera 12 ku buli ludda naye nga mu kisaawe buli ludda oluvuganya (tiimu) luleetamu 7 gwokka. Buli muzannyi alina ekifo mw’azannyira. Buli muzannyi ekifo kye kiragibwa n’ennamba gy’aba ayambadde mu lugoye mw’abakira; ennamba eno ebeera erabika mu maaso n’emabega. Ebifo ebyo bye bino: Omuteebi, omulumbi, abeera wakati, omuzibizi n’omukuumi wa goolo (aziyiza okuteeba). Wabula singa wabaawo abazannyi 5 (mu buli tiimu) ng’abalala tebannatuuka, omuzannyo gusobola okutandika abalala ne babasanga nga bagenda mu maaso. 

Ekigendererwa ky’omuzannyo guno be bazannyi okuteeba goolo nnyingi ddala nga bwe kisoboka. Okuteeba kuno kukolebwa mu kitundu eky’enkulungo ekiyitibwa enkulungo ya goolo. Abazannyi babiri bokka mu buli tiiimu be bakkirizibwa okuteeba goolo era be bano: omulumbi wa goolo n’omuteebi. 

Omuzannyo guno guzannyibwa mu bitunud 4 omubeera okuwummulamu era nga buli luzannya lumala eddakiika 15. Buli luwummulamu lumala eddakiika 3.

Era ng’emizannyo emirala gyonna, n’omuzannyo guno gulimu amateeka. Agamu ku go ge gano: obutalinnya ku kigere kya muzannyi munno, obutasukka ku lukoloboze lw’otalina kusukka. Amateeka ago bw’ogamenya oludda olukoseddwa luweebwa omukisa okukasuka akapiira nga tewali kuziyizibwa. Mu mateeka Malala muliu obutasiikiriza, obutatiisatiisa, n’amalala era gano gasobola okubonerezebwa n’okuweebwa omukisa okuteeba awatali kuziyizibwa. Waliw on’ebintu abazannyi bye batateekwa kuba nabyo gamba ng’ebikwaso, ebyokwewunda ng’ebyoku matu, emikuufu n’obutaba na njala nkulu. Omuzannyi singa agaana okugondera amateeka ago asobola okugaanibwa okuyingira mu kisaawe oba okuggyibwa mu muzannyo.

Omuzannyo guno bwe guba guzannyibwa abazannyi basobola okusikizibwa naye nga kino kibaawo ng’ekitundu ky’omuzannyo ekisooka kiwedde oba nga waliwo omuzannyi akoseddwa.
Omuzannyo guno gunyumira nnyo abantu era gumu ku egyo egivuganyizibwako mu nsi yonna. Ensangi zino waliwo n’abasajja abeenyigira mu muzannyo guno weewaawo nga si bangi. Eri abo abaguzannya, emibiri gyabwe giba gya maanyi era nga miramu bulungi.

Robinah Nabbanja yazaalibwa nga 17 Ntenvu 1969, mukyala musomesa era munnabyabufuzi, era nga ye Ssaabaminisita wa Uganda omukyala asoose mu byafaayo oluvannyuma lw'okulondebwa mu woofiisi eno nga 8 Ssebaaseka 2021. Yakakasibwa Paalamenti mu butongole ku kifo kino nga 21 Ssebaaseka 2021. Yadda mu bigere bya Ruhakana Rugundah, eyalondebwa ku kifo ky'omuwabuzi wa Pulezidenti ku nsonga ez'enkizo mu woofiisi ya Pulezidenti. 

Emabegako, yaweerezaako nga minisita owa guno na guli mu minisitule y'ebyobulamu okuva nga 14 Ntenvu 2019 okutuuka nga 3 Muzigo 2021.

Mu kiseera kino, ye mubaka omukyala akiikirira disitulikiti y'e Kakumiro mu lukiiko lw'eggwanga olukulu. Ekifo kino akibaddemu okuva mu mwaka gwa 2016 okutuuka mu kiseera kino.

Obuvo n'okusoma. 
Wakati wa 1990 ne 2000, Nabbanja yafuna satifikeeti ne dipulooma mu bukulembeze, enzirukanya n'enkulaakulana, okuva ku matendekero ag'enjawulo omwali; Uganda Martyrs University, Uganda Management Institute, Islamic University in Uganda ne National Leadership Institute e Kyankwanzi. Diguli ye esooka yagifuna mu Nteesaganya n'enkulaakulana ne diguli eyookubiri mu Nkulaakulana, zombi yazifunira ku Uganda Martyrs University.
Yazaalibwa mu disitulikiti y'e Kakumiro, nga 17 Ntenvu 1969. Okusoma yakutandikira ku Nkooko Primary Schoola. Oluvannyuma yagenda ku St. Edward's Secondary School e Bukuumi, gye yasomera "O" ne "A level" gya yafunira Uganda Certificate of Education ne Uganda Advanced Certificate of Education

Emirimu 
Okuva mu 1993 okutuuka mu 1996, Nabbanja yali musomesa ku Uganda Martyrs Secondary School e Kakumiro. Yaweerezaako nga kansala wa disitulikiti ng'akiikirira eggombolola y'e Nkooko, nga mu biseera ebyo yali ekyayitibwa disitulikiti y'e Kibaale. Okuva mu 1998 okutuuka mu 2001, yaweerezaako g'omuwandiisi ku kakiiko k'ebyobulamu mu disitulikiti y'e Kakumiro.
Wakati wa 2001 okutuuka mu 2010, yaweerezaako ng'omubaka wa Pulezidenti mu disitulikiti y'e Pallisa, Busia ne Budaka. Mu 2011, yayingira ebyobufuzi eby'okuvuganya era n'avuganya ku ky'omubaka omukyala owa disitulikiti y'e Kibaale mu Paalamenti eyoomwenda. Disitulikiti y'e Kakumiro bwe yatondebwawo mu 2016, yavuganya ku ky'omubaka omukyala owa disitulikiti era n'addamu n'awangula. Mu kiseera kino era y'akyakiikirira ekitundu kino mu Paalamenti y'eggwanga.

Mu nkyukakyuka ezaakolebwa mu baminisita nga 14 Ntenvu 2019, Nabbanja yalondebwa nga minisita owa guno na guli mu minisitule y'ebyobulamu  ng'adda mu bigera bya Sarah Achieng Opendi.

Ebijuliziddwa

Buno bwe bubi obufuluma mu muntu ng'agenze mu kaabuyonjo. Naye olw'okuba ekigambo kino tekiyisika mu kamwa naddala mu bantu abalala, waliwo ebigambo ebirala ebisobola okukozesebwa mu Luganda okutegeeza kino; gamba nga obubi oba empitambi.

Ekitooke bwe kiba kituuse okussaako ettooke, kisooka kussaako empumumpu. Mu nnyinyonnyola ennyangu, tuyinza okugamba nti empumumpu y'ebeera ng'ekimuli ky'ekitooke  ettooke mwe liva ne ligenda nga likula okutuusa eminwe gyonna lwe givaayo. Ettooke bwe lyeyongera okukula, empumumpu esigalako okutuusa omulimi lw'agitemako.

Ekikata y'entuumu y'ettaka entontono omulimi wa lumonde gy'akuŋŋaanya awamu n'asonsekamu amalagala ga lumonde olwo nno n'alinda lumode okukula asobole okweriika  lumonde kawoomera. Okusonseka amalagala ga lumonde mu kikata bakuyita okubyala mu Luganda.

Amalagala ga lumonde biba bikoola okuba n'obuti omulimi by'asonseka mu kikata kya lumonde. Ku buti obuba busonsekeddwa mu kikata ebikoola ne bisigala wabweru w'ekikata kwe kumera emirandira egigenda nga gikulira mu kikata okutuusa lwe gifuuka lumonde. Okusonseka amalagala ga lumonde mu kikata bakuyita okubyala mu Luganda. Amalagala ga lumonde nno gaavaamu n'enjogera egamba nti "akootakoota mu ga lumonde". Ng'amakulu amakusike agali mu njogera eyo gali nti omuntu akola ekintu ky'ataayinze kutuukira oba kufunamu kalungi konna aba amala biseera bye okufaananako ng'omuntu amala ebiseera okugezaako okukootakoota, kwe kugamba okwekweka mu malagala ga lumonde mbu abamunoonya baleme okumulaba.

Esther Mbulakubuza Mbayo (née Esther Mbulakubuza), munnabyabyafuzi omunnayuganda. Ye minisita w'ensonga za pulezidenti mu baminisita ba Uganda. Yalondebwa mu kifo kino nga 6 Ssebaaseka 2016 ng'adda mu kifo kya Frank Tumwebaze, eyalondebwa nga Minisita wa Tekinologiya n'ebyempuliziganya. Era aweereza mu Ssetteeserezo ya Uganda nga omubaka omukyala owa disitulikiti ya Luuka.

Obuvo bwe n'okusoma. 
Yazaalibwa ensangi zino mw'eyitibwa Luuka disitulikiti, mu kitundu kya Busoga, mu buvanjuba bwa Uganda nga, 27 ogwokuna 1971. Yasomera O ne A level ku Wanyange Girls' School. Yeegatta ku Ssettendekero ya Makerere n'atikkirwa digulii mu byobusuubuzi mu 2005 ng'amakanda yagasimba mu kubalirira. Alina ne satifikeeti okuva mu Institute of Chartered Secretaries and Administrators.

Emirimu 
Mu 1997, Yakolako ng'omubaliririzi owoomunda owa Transocean Uganda Limited. Okuva mu Museenene wa 1999 okutuuka 2002, yakola ng'omuyuka w'omubalirizi ku Lonrho Motors Uganda Limited, kkampuni ekola ku bidduka ey'obwannannyini mu Kampala. Okuva mu Gatonnya wa 2002 okutuuka mu Mukutukansanja wa 2006, yakola nga omubalirizi ku Lonrho Motors. Oluvannyuma yagenda okukola ku Commercial Firms Uganda Limited ng'omubalirizi okuva mu Kafuumuulampawu wa 2006 okutuuka mu gwomunaana gwa 2007. Mu kiseera kye kimu okuva mu gwomwenda gwa 2001 okutuuka mu gwomukaaga gwa 2008 yakola nga alungamya eby'ensimbi mmu Socket Works Uganda Limited. Okuva mu gwokubiri gwa 2008 okutuuka mu Ntenvu wa 2010, yakola nga alungamya eby'ensimbi mu Cooper Motor Corporation Uganda. Yalondebwa ng'omubaka omukyala owa Luuka disitulikiti mu kalulu ka bonna mu 2016 nga awangula eyaliyo Evelyn Kaabule. Gwe yali yawangula mu kamyufu NRM. Nga 6 Ssebaaseka 2016, yalondebwa nga Minisita w'ensonga za pulezidenti.

Obuvunaanyizibwa obulala. 
Ekiseera kino akola nga Ssentebe w'olukiiko olutaba akakyala mu kibiina ky'ebyobuuzi ekiri mu buyinza ekya National Resistance Movement era ssaabawandiisi wa Busoga Women Leader’s Association. Yafumbirwa George Mbayo era bazadde ba baana basatu.

Ebijuliziddwa

Jesca Ababiku (eyazaalibwa nga 17 Ogwomusanvu 1975) Munnayuganda omusomesa ate nga munnabyabufuzi. Mu kiseera kino ye Mubaka omukyala mu paalamenti ya Uganda ey'ekkumi akiikirira abantu be Adjumani disitulikiti. Ali mu kibiina ekya National Resistance Movementi(NRM) ekikulemberwa H.E Yoweri Kaguta Museveni Tibuhaburwa, nga ye mukulembeze w'eggwanga lya Uganda aliko.

Beatrice Were (eyazaalibwa awo nga mu 1966) munnayuganda omukuukuutivu mu kulwanisa akawuka ka mukeenenya. Mu mwaka gwa 1991, Were yeezuula ng'alina akawuka akaleeta mukeenenya. Kino nno yakimanya nga wayiseewo omwezi gumu nga bbaawe akawuka keekamu kamututte ezzirakumwa.

Emirimu gye 
Mu 1993, Beatrice Were ng'ali ne banne abalala baatandikawo ekitongole ky'obwannakyewa ekimanyiddwa nga NACWOLA n'ekigendererwa oky'okugatta abakyala mu Uganda abalina akawuka ka mukeenenya wamu n'okutumbula embeera yaabwe ey'obulamu. Were yaweerezaako ng'omukwanaganya ow'oku ntikko mu kitongole kya NACWOLA mu Uganda. Mu ngeri y'emu, yaliko omukwanaganya w'ekitongole ky'ensi yonna eky'abakyala abalina akawuka ka mukeenenya mu Uganda. Mu kaseera kano ye mukwanaganya w'enteekateeka z'okulwanisa akawuka ka mukeenenya mu Uganda.

Beatrice Were ye omu ku bantu abakuukuutivu abeenyigidde mu kaweefube w'okulwanisa akawuka ka mukeenenya. Amanyiddwa olw'okubuulira enjiri y'okulwanisa akawuka ka mukeenenya eyeeyolekera mu nteekateeka ya Ameriica ey'okufufuggaza akawuka ka mukeenenya. Anenya gavumenti ya America olw'okutaataaganya enkola z'okwewala akawuka ka mukeenenya ku lukalu lwa Africa nga yeesiba ku nkola y'okwewala okwegatta erabikira ddala nga teriimu muzinzi era ekosezza obulamu bw'abantu. Okwogera kwe mu lukuŋŋaana lwa mukeenenya olw'ekkuminoomukaaga olw'ensi yonna olwategekebwa mu Toronto mwe yawakanyiza enkola ya "ABC" mu kwewala akawuka ka mukeenenya kwamuweesa ekitiibwa ekitagambika!

Engule z'awangudde 
Were  yaweebwa engule emanyiddwa nga InterAction Humanitarian Award mu mwaka gwa 2003. Mu ngeri y'emu, awangudde engule y'omulwanyirizi w'eddembe ly'obuntu ey'oku ntikko egabibwa ekibiina ekirwanirira era ne kinoonyereza ku ddembe ly'obuntu.
