Bouzid Boushaki (1935 - 2023) yali mujaasi wa Algeria era munnabyabufuzi eyeetaba mu lutalo lw’okwefuga kwa Algeria, era mu kiseera ekyo yali mukulembeze w’ekibiina ky’abakozi mu kibiina kya General Union of Algerian Workers union era nga ye maneja omukulu mu kkampuni za gavumenti mu Algeria.

Amaka 
Bouzid Boushaki yazaalibwa mu 1935 mu kibuga Ménerville (kati Thenia) eky’amatwale ga Bufalansa, mu bukiikaddyo bw’obuvanjuba bw’ekibuga Boumerdès ekiriwo kati mu Kabylia eya wansi, nga kiromita nga 50 mu buvanjuba bw’ekibuga ekinene ekya Algiers n’ensalo y’ebuvanjuba y’olusenyi lw’e Mitidja , ne ye Amaka ag’ekitiibwa gali mu kibiina ky’embeera z’abantu ekya Chorfas Morabitone, abasibuka mu munnaddiini Omusiraamu ow’ekika kya Malikite Sidi Boushaki (1394-1453), eyatandikawo Zawiya wa Sidi Boushaki mu 1442 mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’ettaano.

Kitaawe, Mahamed Boushaki (1907-1995), yazaalibwa mu kyalo kya bajjajjaabwe ekya Soumâa, mu bukiikaddyo bwa Ménerville, era yali afuuse omusuubuzi omugagga mu kitongole kya Algiers, era nnyina ye Fatma Stambouli (1912-1938), yasibuka mu... ekyalo Talilt (Aïth Si Ali) mu commune ya Beni Amrane kati, mu bukiikaddyo bw’essaza ly’e Boumerdès, era Mahamed yali asenze ne kitaawe, munnabyabufuzi Mohamed Seghir Boushaki (1869-1959), wakati mu kibuga Ménerville , gye yaddukanya ne baganda be babiri Ali ne Mohamed kafeero y’Abamoori (emanyiddwa nga Café Bouzid) okumpi n’edduuka ly’eddagala lya Jérôme Zévaco, eyamala ebbanga ng’alondebwa oba okulondebwa okuba meeya w’ekibuga Ménerville.

Bouzid ye mwana owookubiri mu maka gano oluvannyuma lwa mukulu we Boualem Boushaki (1931-2003), era bombi bazaalibwa mu maka g’amaka gano, Villa ennene esangibwa ku Rue Verdun (kati Rue Hocine Koubi) mu Cité Siegwald, okumpi n’eya... ekitebe ky’eggaali y’omukka mu kibuga, mu mayumba g’Abafaransa aba pieds-noirs.

Mu butuufu, ekika ky’Ababerber ekya Boushaki kyali kikoze kinene nnyo mu kuziyiza Abafaransa okuva nga July 5, 1830 mu kiseera Abafaransa bwe baali bawamba Algeria n’okulumba Kasbah ya Algiers, era Sheikh Ali Boushaki (1809-1846 ) yali abadde... omugoberezi wa Emir Abdelkader ne Sheikh Mohamed ben Zamoum mu bayeekera abaali balwanyisa obufuzi bw’amatwale okutuusa lwe yafa mu 1846 mu lutalo n’amagye g’amatwale ag’amagye ga Afrika mu kitundu kya Col des Beni Aïcha (Tizi Naïth Aïcha).

Okuttibwa kw’Abafaransa ku bantu b’oku kyalo Kabyle okwetoloola Ménerville, okuva ku lugendo lwa 1837 okutuuka ku bujeemu bw’Abamokrani mu 1871, kwaleka ebivaamu mu kujjukira okw’omuggundu okw’abantu enzaalwa abaaliwo, era Bouzid Boushaki yaggya ekiwandiiko kye eky’okujjukira okuva mu nnyiriri zino ez’omu kamwa eziddamu okunyumya okutuuka kw’... Omufaransa okutuuka ku kigo n’ekifuba kya bajjajjaabe n’okuttibwa kwa jjajjaawe omukulu Sheikh Ali Boushaki mu 1846 wakati mu lutalo, n’okusaanyaawo enfunda eziwera Zauía ya Sidi Boushaki abajaasi b’amagye ga Bufalansa , era ng’okunyagulula ebikumi n’ebikumi bya hekitaya z’ettaka ly’ebyobulimi n’okuliwa omukisa eri abalimi ku lukalu lwa Bufalansa.

Ebyenjigiriza 
Bouzid Boushaki yayingira omwaka ogusooka mu pulayimale mu September 1942 mu ssomero ly’abalenzi erya Ménerville mu kkampuni y’Abaalgeria enzaalwa abawerako mu baana b’Abafaransa abawerako ab’abasenze aba pieds-noir ab’omu kibuga kino eky’obusimu.

Munne mu kibiina yali mujja we ku ludda lwa kitaawe Rabah Boushaki, mutabani wa Ali Boushaki ne Fatma Bouchou, wamu ne bannaddiini banne Abasiraamu Omar Rahmoune, Chakir Tadjer, Noureddine Mokhtari, Mohamed Bourenane, Ali Bouhaddi, Mohamed Belaïd ne Ali Laoufi.

Ekkubo lyabwe ery’okusoma lyali lyategeezebwa dda, okuva enzaalwa bwe baali tebalina kusukka mutendera gwa pulayimale, era nga balungamizibwa mu kiseera ky’okusoma kwabwe okumpi okusasula obutasoma bwabwe bwokka mu lulimi Olufaransa, olwali lugendereddwamu okubateekateeka okufuuka abakugu abakola ennyo nga balina emirimu egy’akabi mu nfuga y’amatwale.

Mazima ddala, mukulu we Boualem Boushaki yali agobeddwa mu mwaka ogw’okuna mu pulayimale mu June 1942 okufuna omulimu omutono mu kibuga n’aba pieds-noirs, naye kitaawe Mahamed Boushaki yamuteeka mangu mu kkubo erigenda mu buyigirize bwa Koranic mu a Zawía ey’omu kitundu kya Alma (kati Boudouaou), eyitibwa Zawía ey’e Sidi Salem.

Okutandika mu ggwa lya 1942, era wakati mu Operation Torch mu kiseera kya Ssematalo II ekyasaanyaawo ssemazinga wa Bulaaya, Boushaki yatandika okweyoleka mu misomo gino egya pulayimale gye yatandikira okuvuganya okw’amaanyi ne muvuganya we Omufaransa ayitibwa André Ferrer, wadde nga ensonga nti Omusenze Alfred-Henri de Sulauze, meeya w’ekibuga Ménerville mu kiseera ekyo, yakola kinene okukuuma obuwanguzi mu by’ensoma Abafaransa bokka bwe baali banyumirwa.

Bouzid olwo n’anywerera ku misomo gye egy’essomero, era muganda we Boualem n’amukubiriza obutasuula zaouia ye, era Ssematalo II bwe yaggwaako, meeya Jérôme Zévaco, eyali agobeddwa ku mirimu gye mu 1939, era kuno okudda After ettemu eryaliwo nga May 8, 1945, lyawerekerwako enkola ey’obukkakkamu n’okugatta abantu mu nsi eyali eyagala okufuna okusaasira kw’abantu enzaalwa nga bayita mu masomero n’emirimu.

Wadde ng’enkola y’Obwakabaka bwa Bufalansa obw’amatwale yali nzito era ng’enyigirizibwa, Boushaki yatuuka n’okuyita ekigezo kye eky’omwaka ogw’omukaaga mu pulayimale n’obulungi nga July 6, 1948, ng’asinga munne omulala ow’ekika kya pied-noir, Yvon Rocamora, n’abamawulire.Empapula z’amawulire mu Algeria zaasaasaanya bino ebivaamu emirundi egiwerako, mu mbeera eno empapula z’amawulire Alger Républicain ne L’Écho d’Alger.

Olutalo lw'obwetwaze 
Okuva nga November 1, 1954 n’olunaku oluvannyuma lw’enkyukakyuka y’ameefuga ga Algeria okutandika, bwe yali wa myaka 19 gyokka, yali yeetegese bulungi mu magezi, mu byobufuzi ne mu mubiri okukungaanya n’okuwagira abayeekera b’eggwanga lya Algeria okulwanyisa amagye g’omulabe ag’amatwale n’ekigendererwa eky’okusaanyaawo n’okusuula enkola y’amatwale ga Bufalansa mu bujjuvu okuva mu nsi ya Algeria.

Naye olw’okulinnya n’okukula kw’enkola y’olutalo ey’effujjo ku Bafaransa abaali n’emmundu n’abasenze aba pied-noir nga wabulayo akaseera katono olukiiko lw’e Soummam lutegekeddwa nga August 20, 1956 n’ensengeka y’enkyukakyuka mu ttaka lya Algeria, obulumbaganyi obw’emmundu obw’okumenyawo n’... okusaanyawo kwakwasibwa Bouzid Boushaki mu kibuga Ménerville ekyali mu matwale okumalawo puleesa ya Bufalansa ey’okwesasuza ku bitundu ebyetooloddewo eby’ensozi n’ebyalo. Okusaanyawo kuno kwandizingiramu ekibinja ky’enkyukakyuka ekyakulemberwa Boushaki mu kibuga, ekyali kirimu abatujju kkumi. Abatujju bano baali ba kusimba emirandira gy’obuyeekera n’okubunyweza nga balumba ebirungi by’abasenze Abafaransa mu kibuga kino eky’amagezi ekya Ménerville (kati Thénia), ekyali kisangibwa kiromita 3 zokka mu bukiikakkono bw’ekyalo enzaalwa ya Boushaki ekiyitibwa Soumâa.

Mukulu we, Boualem Boushaki, eyali akola nga nnansi mu ddwaaliro ly’e Ménerville, ye yalabirira okulongoosebwa kuno era n’amuwa amawulire ageetaagisa okuteekateeka okuteeka bbomu mu kibangirizi kya Post Office mu maaso g’ekitebe kya commune eky’ekibuga era okutuusa ebyokulwanyisa bino eby’okubwatuka kwalina okukolebwa ng’ekiro kya July 14, 1956 tekinnatuuka, nga kikwatagana n’ebikujjuko by’Abafaransa ebikwata ku mukolo guno omukulu ogwa buli mwaka, olunaku lw’eggwanga lya Bufalansa. Okubwatuka kwa bbomu kwafuuka emitwe gy’amawulire era n’amawulire g’ebibuga Algeria ne Paris naddala okuva mu ofiisi eno eya P.T.T. Yateekebwa mu maaso g’ekibinja kya Bufalansa ekya gendarmerie brigade ekyakakasa okukkakkana kw’ekibuga n’okumenyawo emikutu gy’enkyukakyuka mu Algeria okuliyirira n’okuziyiza ebikolwa eby’enjawulo eby’okusaanyawo eby’obulimi eby’amatwale okwetoloola ekkubo lino ery’obukodyo ery’ekibuga.

Ba kojja ba Bouzid, gamba ng’omukulembeze w’enkyukakyuka Yahia Boushaki (1935-1960) n’omulwanyi w’obuziyiza Mohamed Rahmoune (1940-2022), baatambulatambula mu maquis eyeetoolodde Ménerville ne balumba eby’obulimi n’amagye eby’abasenze Abafaransa, awamu n’okwagala endowooza y’abantu. Ekibuga kyalina okuba eky’akatabanguko era eky’amangu, ne bwe kiba nti ebikolwa bino eby’enkyukakyuka byaggwaawo n’okufa kw’abajulizi (shahid) ku kisaawe ky’ekitiibwa, era eno y’engeri Bouzid Boushaki n’akasenge ke ak’okusaanyawo abaali bateeze mu kibuga gye baalina okuwagira kaweefube w’... abalwanyi b’eggye ly’eggwanga erya National Liberation Army (ALN) mu kibinja kyabwe eky’obuyeekera nga basinziira mu Ménerville, wakati mu disitulikiti y’olutalo olw’okusatu, mu kitundu eky’obwetwaze ekyasooka, ebuvanjuba bwa wilaya ey’okuna ey’ebyafaayo.

Ekkomera 
Bouzid Boushaki yakwatibwa mu ngeri ey’effujjo nga July 4, 1956 poliisi ya Bufalansa n’amagye ga Bufalansa mu maka ga famire ye agasangibwa mu kibuga Ménerville, mu Siegwald, era okukwatibwa kuno nga bukyali kwaliwo oluvannyuma lw’okufuluma kw’amawulire ag’ekikessi agaanyiiza ofiisi ya posita. ekikwekweto ky’okukuba bbomu kyava ku luguudo ne kiremererwa, era bwe kityo kumpi bonna abaali mu kibinja ky’abayeekera mu bibuga baawambibwa ne batulugunyizibwa nga tebannattibwa oba okusibwa. Okutulugunya okunene kwakolebwa ku Boushaki ne banne mu nkambi ya Ferme Gauthier ey’okutulugunya n’okutulugunya abantu mu mubiri esangibwa mu bukiikakkono bw’ekibuga Souk El Had.

Bouzid olwo n’atulugunyizibwa mu ngeri ey’entiisa n’amasannyalaze okuva mu Gégène era n’afuna obuvune obw’obukambwe ate nga naye yaziikibwa n’okuteekebwa mu biyumba ne mujja we Mohamed Rahmoune mu binnya by’ebibbo by’omwenge eby’ekyuma kino ekyakyusibwa, mu bifo ebirala eby’ebyobulimi, abatemu Scarfo ne Mathieu mu nkambi z’abasibe n’okuggyibwawo mu mubiri mu ngeri etali ya mulamuzi.

Abasibe bangi mu kifo kino ekibi era eky’omuzizo eky’okutulugunyizibwa n’okutulugunyizibwa mu ngeri ey’obugwenyufu n’obucaafu baafa olw’ebiwundu, ensisi, obulumi n’okuyisibwa obubi. Bwe kityo, emirambo gyabwe n’ebisigalira byabwe byakwekebwa mu nzizi oba okusuulibwa mu mazzi g’omugga Isser, era abakulembeze b’abayeekera ababiri, Bouzid Boushaki ne Mohamed Rahmoune, ne bakyusibwa olw’omukisa ogw’ekyamagero, oluvannyuma lwa wiiki ntono nga batulugunyizibwa, ne batwalibwa mu kkomera ly’e Serkadji mu Kasbah y’e Algiers n’abakulembeze b’enkyukakyuka mu kitundu abagenda okusalirwa omusango.

Okufa 
Bouzid Boushaki yafiira mu 2023 mu nnyumba ye esangibwa ku Ali Anou Street, okuliraana ebyalo Soumâa, Gueddara ne Meraldene.

Olwo n’aziikibwa okumpi ne kitaawe, Si Mahamed Boushaki (1907-1995), era okumpi ne jjajjaawe Mohamed Seghir Boushaki (1869-1959), ne muganda we Boualem Boushaki (1931-2003), mu ssabo ly’Abasiraamu erya Thénia eriyitibwa Djebbana Aba Ghorba.

Enkola y’okuddukanya ebirimu (CMS) ye pulogulaamu ya kompyuta ekozesebwa okuddukanya okutonda n’okukyusa ebirimu ebya digito (okuddukanya ebirimu).[1]CMS etera okukozesebwa mu kuddukanya ebirimu mu kitongole (ECM) n’okuddukanya ebirimu ku mukutu (WCM).[2]

ECM etera okuwagira abakozesa abawera mu mbeera ey’okukolagana[4] nga egatta okuddukanya ebiwandiiko, okuddukanya eby’obugagga bya digito, n’okukuuma ebiwandiiko.

Ekirala, WCM ye nkola y’okuwandiika ey’okukolagana ku mikutu gya yintaneeti era eyinza okubeeramu ebiwandiiko n’okuyingiza ebifaananyi, ebifaananyi, vidiyo, amaloboozi, maapu, ne koodi ya pulogulaamu eziraga ebirimu n’okukolagana n’omukozesa. ECM mu bujjuvu erimu omulimu gwa WCM.

Buddha (ekyasa eky’omukaaga–okutaano B.C.E.) yali musomesa muyindi era nga ye yatandikawo enzikiriza ya Buddha. Buddha yali abeera mu bukiikakkono bwa Buyindi essaawa emu wakati w’ekyasa eky’omukaaga n’eky’okutaano nga Omulembe ogwa Wamu tegunnabaawo.

Enzikiriza ya Buddha y’eddiini esinga obungi mu Bhutan, Myanmar, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Mongolia, Laos, China, Hong Kong, Japan, Tibet, North Korea, South Korea, Macau, Singapore, Taiwan, Kalmykia, ne Vietnam. Abantu abangi aba Buddha babeera mu.

Abeno Harukas(あべのハルカス) - wazimbibwa wa Japan.
